w.name: Vivid Notions
w.text: Provides 44.1% CRIT DMG, 28% ATK, and up to 68% Plunging Attack CRIT DMG at R1, making it Varesa’s signature and best-in-slot weapon.

w.name: Kagura's Verity
w.text: Provides 66.2% CRIT DMG and boosts Elemental Skill DMG and overall Elemental DMG, making it a strong 5-star alternative for Varesa.

w.name: The Widsith
w.text: Provides 55.1% CRIT DMG and a random ATK, Elemental DMG, or EM buff, offering strong but inconsistent damage boosts for Varesa.

w.name: Flowing Purity
w.text: A craftable ATK% catalyst that increases Elemental DMG after Skill use. Healing clears its Bond of Life for an extra damage bonus.

a.text: Greatly increases Plunging Attack damage by building stacks from Varesa’s combat actions. One of her strongest overall sets.
Grants 40% CRIT Rate after consuming Nightsoul points, making it a powerful alternative for Varesa. Avoid overcapping CRIT Rate.

names: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
a.text: Provides 36% ATK, making it a solid 2-piece combination for boosting Varesa’s Plunging Attack damage.

t.name: Plunge & Punishment
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Mavuika adds off-field Pyro and buffs, Iansan boosts ATK, and Chevreuse provides healing, ATK buffs, and Pyro/Electro RES shred.

t.name: Natlan CrossFit
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Durin adds off-field Pyro, Iansan boosts ATK, and Chevreuse heals, buffs ATK, and shreds Pyro/Electro RES.

t.name: Air Traffic Control
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Furina provides Hydro application and DMG buffs, Iansan boosts ATK, and Xianyun buffs Plunging Attacks and heals.

t.name: Bat Mobile
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Mavuika provides off-field Pyro and buffs, Ororon adds Electro damage and Scroll buffs, and Chevreuse heals, boosts ATK, and shreds Pyro/Electro RES.

seo.about: Varesa is a 5-star Electro Main DPS built around fast Charged Attacks and powerful Plunging Attacks. Her Skill builds Nightsoul points, unlocking an enhanced state and a special Burst for high Plunge damage.
weapons: Lost Prayer to the Sacred Winds

sets: A Day Carved From Rising Winds

w.name: Peak Patrol Song
w.text: High DEF and powerful team Elemental DMG buffs after Normal Attacks. Excellent for boosting total team damage.

w.name: Uraku Misugiri
w.text: High CRIT DMG, DEF and Skill damage bonuses. Excellent for maximizing Albedo’s personal damage.

w.name: Cinnabar Spindle
w.text: R5 boosts Skill damage based on DEF. Excellent for off-field Transient Blossoms; only available from a past event.

w.name: Harbinger of Dawn
w.text: F2P CRIT option with R5 CRIT Rate bonus while above 90% HP. Loses much of its value if Albedo falls below that threshold.

w.name: Primordial Jade Cutter
w.text: CRIT Rate substat with HP-scaled ATK.

w.name: Flute of Ezpitzal
w.text: Craftable DEF% sword that improves Albedo’s DEF-scaling Skill damage. Accessible alternative when premium options are unavailable.

w.name: Wolf-Fang
w.text: Battle Pass CRIT Rate option with Skill damage bonuses. More appealing at higher refinements; consider existing free options first.

a.text: Boosts DEF and Geo DMG, strengthening Transient Blossoms. Excellent for Albedo’s personal off-field damage.
Boosts off-field Elemental Skill damage. Strong alternative to Husk, depending on weapon and team buffs.
After using his Skill, grants team Elemental DMG buffs, strengthened by Hexerei: Secret Rite. Best for team support.

t.name: Rock & Reload
t.text: Navia leads on-field Geo damage, Albedo adds off-field Geo damage and Crystallize, Durin provides Pyro application and RES shred, and Nicole supplies teamwide ATK buffs and shielding.

t.name: Chemical Romance
t.text: Albedo provides off-field Geo damage and team buffs, Lohen leads on-field Cryo damage, Durin adds off-field Pyro damage and Melt synergy, and Nicole boosts the team while providing shielding.

t.name: Fullmetal Father
t.text: Albedo adds off-field Geo damage and Crystallize, Arlecchino leads on-field Pyro damage, Xilonen shreds RES and boosts elemental damage, and Nicole provides ATK buffs and shielding.

t.name: Hopeless Impact
t.text: Noelle leads on-field Geo damage and provides healing, Albedo adds off-field Geo damage, Durin contributes Pyro damage and Geo RES shred, and Gorou boosts DEF and Geo damage.

seo.about: Albedo is a low-field-time Geo off-field DPS who deals in consistent DEF scaling damage. His Hexerei upgrades boost both his damage and team utility.
cons: Constructs can break if not Hex

w.name: Fang of the Mountain King
w.text: His signature boosts Skill and Burst damage as he gains stacks from Skill hits and Burning or Burgeon reactions.

w.name: A Thousand Blazing Suns
w.text: Grants massive ATK and CRIT DMG buffs during Nightsoul's Blessing, boosting Kinich's first few Scalespiker Cannons. Limited uptime.

w.name: Beacon of the Reed Sea
w.text: Provides 33.1% CRIT Rate and ATK buffs from Skill hits and taking damage. Best without shields, but watch for CRIT overcap.

w.name: Earth Shaker
w.text: It's one of Kinich's best accessible weapons, and a very reasonable choice for players who don't want to spend on a Battle Pass or weapon banner.

a.text: Provides 15% DMG Bonus and 40% CRIT Rate while Kinich consumes Nightsoul points, making it his best-in-slot artifact set.
Provides 18% ATK and up to 50% DMG Bonus while Burning enemies are present, making it a strong alternative for Kinich in Burning teams.
Provides 15% Dendro DMG and 20% Elemental Skill DMG, offering a flexible option for boosting Kinich’s Dendro and Skill damage.

t.name: Kinich Me Outside
t.text: Kinich drives on-field Burning damage, Emilie adds off-field Dendro damage, Nicole provides ATK buffs and shielding, and Durin supplies Pyro application, Dendro RES shred, and off-field damage.

t.name: Ajaw & Order
t.text: Kinich deals powerful Skill damage while Emilie adds Dendro damage. Mavuika maintains Pyro for Burning, and Bennett provides healing and ATK buffs.

t.name: Let Him Cook
t.text: Kinich drives Burning damage, Xiangling maintains Pyro, and Bennett heals and buffs ATK. Iansan offers extra ATK support, though another Dendro support may offer more.

t.name: Free to Burn
t.text: Kinich drives Burning damage, Pyro Traveler provides off-field Pyro and buffs, Bennett boosts ATK and heals, and Iansan adds ATK buffs and DMG Bonus.

why.v:
Prioritize Kinich's Skill damage with consistent Burning, strong ATK buffs, and a teammate carrying Deepwood Memories.
Add Hydro and off-field Pyro for Burgeon reactions while preserving enough Burning uptime for frequent Scalespiker Cannons.
A strong alternative to Obsidian Codex in Burning teams, especially with excellent substats or a CRIT Rate weapon.
Use craftable Earth Shaker and Obsidian Codex with affordable Pyro supports to maximize Scalespiker Cannon damage.
Focus on ATK and CRIT instead of excessive ER when Bursting every rotation would sacrifice valuable Skill damage.

seo.about: Kinich is a 5★ Dendro on-field DPS who builds Nightsoul points to fire powerful Scalespiker Cannons. Burning and Burgeon help him generate points faster and maximize his damage.

w.name: Astral Vulture's Crimson Plumage
w.text: Provides massive CRIT DMG, ATK, Charged Attack, and Burst bonuses that directly boost Chasca’s overall damage.

w.name: Aqua Simulacra
w.text: Provides massive CRIT DMG and a universal DMG bonus, making it an excellent 5-star alternative for boosting Chasca’s overall damage.

w.name: The First Great Magic
w.text: Provides CRIT DMG and Charged Attack damage. Its ATK and movement effects depend on the party’s elemental composition.

w.name: Thundering Pulse
w.text: Offers high CRIT DMG and an ATK bonus, but its Normal Attack passive is poorly suited to Chasca’s charged shots.

w.name: Flower-Wreathed Feathers
w.text: Offers ATK and strong Charged Attack bonuses. A particularly good four-star option at higher refinements.

w.name: Scion of the Blazing Sun
w.text: Provides CRIT Rate and increases Charged Attack DMG after hitting an enemy, making it a solid 4-star option for Chasca.

w.name: Song of Stillness
w.text: Craftable ATK bow that boosts damage after receiving healing. Works best with healers who can trigger its passive reliably.

w.name: Blackcliff Warbow
w.text: Offers CRIT DMG, but its passive needs enemy defeats and is unreliable against bosses. A situational shop option.

a.text: Provides a huge CRIT Rate boost during Nightsoul’s Blessing, making it Chasca’s strongest general damage set.
Gives substantial CRIT Rate when Furina enables consistent HP changes. A strong alternative to Obsidian Codex.
Reduces enemy elemental resistance through Swirl, but is less effective for Chasca’s personal damage than Codex.

t.name: Hexecutioners
t.text: Chasca uses converted shells for damage. Iansan provides ATK buffs, Durin contributes Pyro damage, and Nicole supports the team.

t.name: Starstruck
t.text: Chasca deals converted elemental damage while Odette, Nicole, and Yae Miko contribute their own support and off-field effects.

t.name: Moonstruck
t.text: Chasca drives converted elemental damage, Columbina boosts Lunar reactions, Ineffa provides off-field Electro and Lunar-Charged damage, and Nicole buffs the team and strengthens Hexerei synergy.

t.name: Budget Airlines
t.text: Chasca drives elemental damage, Ororon provides off-field Electro and buffs, Bennett boosts ATK and heals, and Diona provides shielding and healing

seo.about: Chasca is an Anemo Bow damage dealer who takes flight and fires elemental shells during her Skill. Her damage depends on Pyro, Hydro, Electro, and Cryo teammates.

w.name: Splendor of Tranquil Waters
w.text: Splendor maximizes Furina’s damage, while Favonius can be better in Stygian for team Energy and Burst uptime.

w.name: Key of Khaj-Nisut
w.text: Key of Khaj-Nisut boosts Furina’s HP and provides additional teamwide EM, strengthening her HP-scaling damage and reaction support.

w.name: Primordial Jade Cutter
w.text: Primordial Jade Cutter provides CRIT Rate and HP, improving Furina’s personal damage and HP-scaling Skill.

w.name: Favonius Sword
w.text: Favonius provides Energy Recharge and generates teamwide particles, helping Furina maintain Burst uptime and support the entire team.

w.name: The Dockhand's Assistant
w.text: Provides HP, then grants Elemental Mastery and restores Energy after using a Skill or Burst with healing stacks.

w.name: Festering Desire
w.text: Budget pick: Energy Recharge plus Skill CRIT Rate and Skill DMG.

w.name: Fleuve Cendre Ferryman
w.text: Free fishing sword: Energy Recharge substat, Skill CRIT Rate, and bonus ER after casting Skill.

w.name: Wolf-Fang
w.text: Gives CRIT Rate and boosts Skill damage. Its stacking CRIT passive is awkward for an off field Furina.

a.text: Golden Troupe boosts Furina’s Elemental Skill damage by up to 70%, making it her best set for off-field damage.
Tenacity boosts Furina’s HP and provides a teamwide ATK buff, offering support for ATK-scaling carries at the cost of her personal damage.
Combines an HP boost with Hydro DMG Bonus to strengthen Furina’s Skill damage.

t.name: Fine Dining & Violence
t.text: Skirk drives on-field Cryo damage, Furina provides Hydro application and DMG buffs, Escoffier shreds Cryo/Hydro RES and heals, and Vodyanitsa adds further RES shred and damage buffs.

t.name: Divas & Detonations
t.text: Navia drives Geo damage, Furina buffs the team and enables Crystallize, Columbina supports Lunar reactions, and Linnea provides healing and Geo buffs.

t.name: Furina’s Fitness Club
t.text: Varesa drives Electro damage, Furina provides off-field Hydro and DMG buffs, Xilonen shreds RES and heals, and Iansan boosts ATK and provides additional support.

t.name: Lohen Up Places
t.text: Lohen drives Freeze damage, Furina provides Hydro and DMG buffs, Escoffier shreds Cryo/Hydro RES and heals, and Mona boosts damage with Omen and Hexerei buffs

seo.about: Furina is a universal buffer and Sub-DPS, boosting nearly all forms of team damage while dealing impressive damage herself. She needs strong healers to quickly build Fanfare.
stats: Energy Recharge: 130% to 200%+ depending on team

w.name: Starsealed Edict
w.text: Provides 88.2% CRIT DMG, up to 168 EM, and up to 36% Stellar-Conduct CRIT DMG at R1, making it Mitya’s signature and best-in-slot weapon.

w.name: A Thousand Floating Dreams
w.text: Provides 265 EM and grants Mitya additional EM plus 40 teamwide EM at R1, making it an excellent off-field support option.

w.name: Kagura's Verity
w.text: Kagura’s Verity boosts Mitya’s Elemental Skill damage and CRIT DMG, making it a strong offensive option for personal damage.

w.name: Winter's Heavy Heart
w.text: Provides 55.1% CRIT DMG and boosts EM and Stellar Glimmer damage based on Cryo and Electro teammates, making it a strong 4-star option for Mitya.

w.name: Clash of Kings
w.text: Provides 27.6% CRIT Rate and, after using an Elemental Skill, grants ATK and EM bonuses, making it a strong 4-star option for Mitya.

a.text: Boosts Stellar-Conduct damage and CRIT Rate under its reaction conditions. Focus on EM and CRIT stats rather than the set’s ATK bonus.
Provides 80 EM and up to 150 additional EM or 42% ATK, boosting Mitya’s reaction damage and ATK scaling.
Grants 18% ATK and boosts teamwide Stellar Glimmer DMG by 50%, making it a strong off-field support set for Mitya.

t.name: On-Field Live Wire
t.text: Mitya takes the field for Stellar-Conduct damage. Yae provides off-field Electro attacks, while Odette and Valeriy enable and support his reaction damage.

t.name: Off-Field Puppet
t.text: Sandrone drives on-field Cryo and Stellar-Conduct damage, Odette enables Stellar-Conduct, Valeriy provides off-field Electro support, and Mitya adds off-field damage and reaction support.

t.name: Maximum Security
t.text: Wriothesley drives on-field Cryo damage, Mitya provides off-field damage and Stellar-Conduct support, Cryo Traveler adds Cryo application, and Valeriy provides Electro support.

t.name: Economitya F2P
t.text: Mitya deals reaction damage while Valeriy applies Electro. Sucrose groups enemies and shares EM, and Qiqi provides healing and Cryo application.

seo.about: Flexible Stellar-Conduct unit who can be played as either an on-field DPS or off-field support. His C0 dmg is solid, while his Cons significantly boost both his personal dmg and team utility.

w.name: Summit Shaper
w.text: Summit Shaper gives Valeriy massive ATK scaling, strengthening his ATK-based shields and support buffs/increases ATK when shielded.

w.name: Skyward Blade
w.text: High Base ATK boosts his support scaling, while ER improves Burst uptime.

w.name: Calamity of Eshu
w.text: Provides 27.6% ATK to strengthen Valeriy's ATK-scaling shield and support buffs. While shielded, its passive also boosts his special Charged Attack's damage and CRIT Rate.

w.name: Amenoma Kageuchi
w.text: Amenoma Kageuchi provides substantial ATK% and passive Energy restoration, helping Valeriy maintain his Burst uptime.

w.name: Finale of the Deep
w.text: Provides ATK% and an additional ATK increase after using a Skill. Its Bond of Life mechanic is best handled with reliable healing.

a.text: Heart of the Furnace boosts Valeriy's ATK and can provide a massive teamwide Stellar Glimmer DMG bonus when he triggers the reaction.
Noblesse Oblige is a strong alternative for Valeriy, providing a 20% teamwide ATK buff after his Burst, especially when another teammate already carries Heart of the Furnace.
Combines two ATK bonuses for a simple support build when a suitable four-piece set is unavailable.

t.name: Current Situation
t.text: Mitya drives SSC damage, Odette amplifies reactions, Sucrose boosts EM and shreds RES, and Valeriy provides buffs and team support.

t.name: Short Circuit
t.text: Cyno drives sustained Electro damage, Odette amplifies reactions, Sucrose boosts EM and shreds RES, and Valeriy provides buffs and team support.

t.name: Guilty as Charged
t.text: Clorinde drives Electro damage, Durin enables reactions, Chevreuse boosts Overloaded damage and shreds RES, while Valeriy provides buffs and team support.

t.name: Budget Conductors
t.text: Mitya drives SSC damage, Cryo Traveler supports Cryo application, Sucrose boosts EM and shreds RES, and Valeriy provides buffs and team support.

seo.about: Valeriy is a flexible support who provides shielding and buffs Electro teams, especially those built around SSC. Best in teams that can fully use his buffs. He is a specialized support.

w.name: Gest of the Mighty Wolf
w.text: Provides 33.1% CRIT Rate, 10% ATK SPD, and stacking DMG and CRIT DMG bonuses, perfectly complementing Varka’s fast attacks and Hexerei synergy.

w.name: A Thousand Blazing Suns
w.text: Provides CRIT Rate, massive ATK, and CRIT DMG buffs, making it a powerful 5-star alternative that boosts Varka’s overall damage.

w.name: Serpent Spine
w.text: Provides CRIT Rate and stacking DMG bonuses, making it a strong 4-star option as long as Varka avoids taking damage.

w.name: Prototype Archaic
w.text: Provides a high Base ATK and ATK% bonus, making it a reliable craftable F2P option for Varka.

names: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
a.text: Provides 18% ATK from its 2-piece bonus and 25% ATK plus 20% CRIT Rate from its 4-piece bonus, making it Varka’s best-in-slot set.
Provides Anemo DMG, 40% Normal/Charged Attack DMG, and 10% ATK SPD, making it a solid alternative if you already have strong pieces.
A temporary mixed set for Anemo and infused damage. The best choice depends on Varka’s elemental teammates.

t.name: Knight Shift
t.text: Varka drives Anemo and Pyro damage, Venti groups enemies and shreds RES, Nicole provides ATK buffs and shielding, and Durin adds off-field Pyro damage and RES shred.

t.name: Prune & Punishment
t.text: Varka drives Anemo and Cryo damage, Prune provides teamwide buffs and Anemo support, Odette enables Stellar Swirl and adds Cryo damage, and Qiqi provides healing and additional Cryo application.

t.name: Watt the Fischl
t.text: Varka drives Anemo and Electro damage, Prune provides ATK and DMG buffs, Ineffa adds off-field Electro and Lunar-Charged damage, and Fischl supplies additional Electro damage.

t.name: Category Varka
t.text: Varka drives Anemo and Hydro damage, Prune provides ATK and DMG buffs, Furina adds off-field Hydro damage and team buffs, and Vodyanitsa heals, shreds RES, and boosts Varka’s damage.

seo.about: Varka is an Anemo on-field DPS built around fast, aggressive combat and reaction driven teams. He shines with strong supports, especially in Stellar Swirl teams.

sets: A Day Carved From Rising Winds

w.name: Wolf's Gravestone
w.text: Provides a large ATK boost. Hitting a low HP enemy can trigger a temporary ATK buff for the whole party.

w.name: Redhorn Stonethresher
w.text: Redhorn provides massive CRIT DMG and boosts Diluc's Normal and Charged Attack damage, making it a strong CRIT-focused alternative.

w.name: Serpent Spine
w.text: Provides CRIT Rate and stacking damage bonuses while Diluc stays on field. A strong Battle Pass choice if he avoids taking damage.

w.name: Blackcliff Slasher
w.text: Provides CRIT DMG and stacking ATK after defeating enemies. Best against waves rather than single bosses.

w.name: Rainslasher
w.text: Budget Vaporize option: Elemental Mastery substat and 20% extra damage against Hydro - or Electro…

w.name: Mailed Flower
w.text: Gives Elemental Mastery and grants ATK and more EM after using his Skill or triggering a reaction. Good for Vaporize teams.

a.text: Crimson Witch boosts Diluc's Pyro damage and reaction damage, making it ideal for maximizing his Vaporize and Melt potential.
Marechaussee Hunter provides up to 36% CRIT Rate when Diluc's HP fluctuates, making it a strong option for consistent CRIT builds.
Gilded Dreams boosts Diluc's EM and ATK, improving his Vaporize and Melt damage through stronger reactions.

t.name: Melt Force One
t.text: Diluc delivers powerful Plunge attacks, Xianyun enables Plunging and boosts damage, Citlali provides Melt support and RES shred, and Bennett buffs ATK.

t.name: Splash Landing
t.text: Furina's HP fluctuations activate Marechaussee Hunter's 36% CRIT Rate bonus, while Xianyun enables Plunges and Bennett boosts Diluc's ATK.

t.name: Dawn & Tonic
t.text: Diluc delivers powerful Plunge attacks, Xianyun enables Plunging, Kazuha boosts Pyro damage and shreds RES, and Bennett provides massive ATK buffs.

t.name: F2P-Wan Kenobi
t.text: Diluc drives Pyro damage, Xingqiu enables consistent Vaporize, Sucrose boosts EM and shreds RES, and Bennett provides ATK buffs and healing.

seo.about: Diluc is a 5-star Pyro Claymore DPS with straightforward combos and strong reaction damage. His flexible Skill and low-cost Burst make him easy to play, especially in Vaporize and Plunge teams.

w.name: Surf's Up
w.text: Surf’s Up provides massive CRIT DMG, boosts Mualani’s HP, and increases her Normal Attack damage, making it her best-in-slot weapon for powerful Sharky’s Bites and Vaporize hits.

w.name: Tome of the Eternal Flow
w.text: Tome of the Eternal Flow provides massive CRIT DMG and HP%, boosting Mualani’s damage, though its Charged Attack bonus is less useful since her Sharky’s Bites deal Normal Attack damage.

w.name: Sacrificial Jade
w.text: Sacrificial Jade provides CRIT Rate, a massive HP boost, and EM to strengthen Mualani’s Vaporize damage—but watch for CRIT overcapping with Obsidian Codex.

w.name: Ring of Yaxche
w.text: Ring of Yaxche provides a hefty HP% boost and increases Mualani’s Normal Attack damage after using her Skill, making it a strong craftable F2P option.

w.name: The Widsith
w.text: On-switch random buffs include Elemental Mastery or DMG%.

a.text: Obsidian Codex provides 15% increased damage and 40% CRIT Rate, making it Mualani’s best set and freeing up artifact substats for HP%, EM, and CRIT DMG.
Unfinished Reverie boosts Mualani’s damage against Burning enemies, making it a niche option for Burn-Vape teams.
Marechaussee Hunter provides 15% Normal Attack DMG and up to 36% CRIT Rate with Furina, making it a solid alternative for Mualani’s Sharky’s Bites. Obsidian Codex remains stronger overall.

t.name: Sharknado
t.text: Mavuika applies Pyro for Mualani to Vaporize. Xilonen supports her damage, while Citlali offers shielding but can complicate Pyro aura management.

t.name: Shark Week
t.text: Mualani drives Vaporize damage, Mavuika provides off-field Pyro, Emilie adds Burning damage, and Xilonen shreds RES and buffs the team.

t.name: Jaws & Order
t.text: Furina buffs Mualani but her Hydro can compete for the Pyro aura. Xiangling must maintain strong Pyro application, while Xilonen heals and shreds RES.

t.name: Coupon Cabana
t.text: Mualani drives Vaporize damage, Xiangling provides Pyro, Yaoyao heals and supports Bloom reactions, and Sucrose boosts EM and shreds RES.

seo.about: Mualani is an HP scaling Hydro DPS built around huge, front loaded Sharky’s Bite damage. She excels in Vaporize teams, trading rapid attacks for fewer, massive hits.

w.name: Disaster and Remorse
w.text: Provides 22.1% CRIT Rate and boosts Normal, Charged, Skill, and Burst DMG by 40% at R1. Its bonuses increase by 75% with Hexerei: Secret Rite, making it Lohen’s signature and best-in-slot weapon.

w.name: Staff of Homa
w.text: Provides 66.2% CRIT DMG, 20% HP, and an ATK bonus based on Max HP, making it a strong 5-star alternative for Lohen.

w.name: Deathmatch
w.text: Provides 36.8% CRIT Rate and up to 24% ATK at R1 against fewer than two enemies, making it a strong 4-star alternative for Lohen.

w.name: Missive Windspear
w.text: Provides 41.3% ATK and, at R5, grants 24% ATK and 96 EM after triggering an Elemental Reaction, making it a solid F2P option for Lohen.

w.name: Tamayuratei no Ohanashi
w.text: stacks granted on Skill use — the combo already casts Skill once every cycle.

names: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
a.text: Provides 18% ATK and up to 25% additional ATK plus 20% CRIT Rate after Witch’s Homework, making it Lohen’s best-in-slot artifact set.
Provides 15% Cryo DMG and up to 40% CRIT Rate against Cryo-affected or Frozen enemies, making it a situational alternative for Lohen in Freeze teams.
Provides 15% Normal and Charged Attack DMG and up to 36% CRIT Rate when HP changes, making it a situational option for Lohen if his team provides consistent HP fluctuations.

t.name: Witch Please
t.text: Lohen deals Cryo damage and can trigger Reverse Melt using Durin’s Pyro application. Nicole buffs the team, while Citlali shields and supports reactions.

t.name: Blizzard Queen
t.text: Lohen drives on-field Cryo damage, Furina provides Hydro application and DMG buffs, Citlali adds shielding and Cryo application, and Escoffier provides healing, Cryo RES shred, and off-field damage.

t.name: Amber Alerted Us
t.text: Lohen drives on-field Cryo damage, Vodyanitsa provides Hydro application, healing, and RES shred, Mona boosts damage with Omen, and Escoffier adds Cryo/Hydro RES shred and healing.

t.name: Lohen at Home
t.text: Xiangling maintains Pyro for Lohen to trigger Reverse Melt. Bennett heals and buffs ATK, while Sucrose shares EM and lowers Cryo resistance when she swirls Cryo.

seo.about: Lohen is an on-field Cryo DPS who builds resources to unleash powerful Skill attacks. He rewards strong rotations and active off-field teammates.

sets: A Day Carved From Rising Winds

w.name: Azurelight
w.text: Provides 22.1% CRIT Rate and, at R1, grants 48% ATK and 40% CRIT DMG when Skirk has 0 Energy after using her Skill. Her signature weapon and best-in-slot choice.

w.name: Haran Geppaku Futsu
w.text: Provides 33.1% CRIT Rate and 12% Elemental DMG Bonus, with additional Normal Attack DMG after using Skirk’s Skill. A strong 5-star alternative and one of her best non-signature weapons.

w.name: Calamity of Eshu
w.text: Provides 27.6% ATK and, at R5, grants 40% Normal and Charged Attack DMG plus 16% CRIT Rate while shielded. An excellent F2P option for on-field Skirk, but much weaker for quickswap play.

w.name: Finale of the Deep
w.text: Provides 27.6% ATK and, at R5, grants 24% ATK after using an Elemental Skill, plus up to 300 bonus ATK when its Bond of Life is cleared. Skirk’s best freely accessible 4-star option, especially with a healer to clear the Bond of Life.

a.text: Her preferred Cryo damage set when building around her unique resource system. It boosts Normal Attack damage and enhances her damage when Energy is at zero.

Provides 15% Normal and Charged Attack DMG and up to 36% CRIT Rate when HP changes. Furina reliably activates the full bonus through her HP drain, making this a strong option for on-field Skirk. Watch your CRIT Rate, especially with Azurelight—the set can cause overcapping.
A temporary ATK and Normal Attack option for on-field Skirk. Farm Finale of the Deep Galleries for a stronger dedicated set.

t.name: ABYSS & BOUJE
t.text: Skirk leads on-field Cryo damage, Furina provides off-field Hydro and a massive teamwide DMG Bonus, Vodyanitsa adds Hydro support, RES shred, and powerful damage buffs, while Escoffier provides Cryo application, additional RES shred, and healing.

t.name: FROST & FURIOUS
t.text: Skirk deals on-field Cryo damage, Furina buffs and applies Hydro, Citlali shields and shreds RES, and Escoffier heals while boosting Cryo/Hydro damage.

t.name: COLD HARD FACTS
t.text: Skirk deals on-field Cryo damage, Xingqiu provides off-field Hydro, Charlotte offers teamwide healing and TTDS buffs, and Escoffier heals while shredding Cryo/Hydro RES.

t.name: BUDGET ABYSS
t.text: Skirk deals on-field Cryo damage, Xingqiu provides off-field Hydro, Rosaria boosts CRIT Rate and adds Cryo damage, and Dahlia shields Skirk while increasing her Attack SPD.

seo.about: Skirk is a powerful Cryo DPS who excels with Cryo and Hydro allies. Her unique resource system lets her unleash devastating attacks without relying on Energy.

w.name: Beyond the Chrysalis
w.text: Provides 44.1% CRIT DMG, up to 56% additional CRIT DMG, 36% Stellar Swirl DMG, and 5 Energy

w.name: Whitelake Frostfeather
w.text: Provides 22.1% CRIT Rate, up to 24% ATK, 50% Stellar Glimmer CRIT DMG, and 4 Energy at R1. A strong 5-star alternative for Vesna.

w.name: New Bough
w.text: Provides 55.1% CRIT DMG, up to 18% ATK, and 24% Stellar Glimmer DMG at R1, making it a strong 4-star option for Vesna.

w.name: Heretic's Molten Blade
w.text: Provides 165 EM, 16% ATK, and 16% Stellar Glimmer DMG at R1, making it a strong craftable F2P option for Vesna.

w.name: Emberwell
w.text: An accessible Elemental Mastery option when your stronger damage weapons are unavailable.

a.text: Scarlet Proof is Vesna’s BiS because it gives her 18% ATK, plus 16% CRIT Rate and 40% Stellar Swirl DMG for 10 seconds after triggering Stellar Swirl.
Viridescent Venerer is a strong alternative, boosting Stellar Swirl DMG by 20% and shredding infused elemental RES by 40%, plus Cryo RES by 40%. Scarlet Proof remains her BiS for personal damage.

names: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
a.text: Combines 36% ATK from both 2-piece bonuses, providing a strong placeholder build while farming Scarlet Proof. It boosts Vesna’s ATK-scaling damage but lacks the CRIT Rate and Stellar Swirl DMG bonuses of her 4-piece BiS.

t.name: Category Five
t.text: Vesna deals Stellar Swirl damage while Odette supplies Cryo and reaction support. Vodyanitsa heals and buffs, and Faruzan strengthens Anemo damage.

t.name: Celestial Spending
t.text: Odette enables Stellar Swirl and adds Cryo support. Vodyanitsa heals and buffs, while Nicole protects and strengthens Vesna’s damage.

t.name: WEATHER ADVISORY
t.text: Furina buffs damage and applies Hydro, Vodyanitsa heals and shreds RES, and Faruzan boosts Anemo damage and shreds Anemo RES.

t.name: TEMU TORNADO
t.text: Cryo Traveler enables Stellar Swirl. Xingqiu adds Hydro through Normal Attack triggers, while Sucrose offers grouping and Elemental Mastery support.

seo.about: Vesna is an Anemo DPS who excels in stellar-swirl teams with powerful skill based damage. She rewards frequent reactions and strong off-field teammates.

sets: A Day Carved From Rising Winds

w.name: Nocturne's Curtain Call
w.text: Provides CRIT DMG, HP bonuses, and Energy restoration. Greatly boosts Columbina’s Lunar Reaction CRIT damage.

w.name: Sacrificial Jade
w.text: Sacrificial Jade provides Columbina with 36.8% CRIT Rate, HP%, and EM, boosting her personal damage and Lunar Reaction scaling as an off-field sub-DPS.

w.name: Prototype Amber
w.text: Provides HP%, Burst Energy, and teamwide healing, making it a reliable F2P support option.

w.name: Favonius Codex
w.text: Provides Energy Recharge and teamwide particle generation, helping Columbina and her teammates maintain Burst uptime.

a.text: Provides Energy Recharge and team buffs for Lunar reactions. Excellent when no teammate is already using this support set.
Boosts Columbina’s personal Lunar Reaction damage. Best when another teammate already carries Silken Moon’s Serenade.
Boosts Columbina’s HP and provides a teamwide ATK buff, making it a useful support set for ATK-scaling DPS teams.

t.name: Watt the Flins
t.text: Flins drives Lunar-Charged damage, Ineffa provides Electro, Columbina buffs Lunar reactions, and Sucrose boosts EM and shreds RES.

t.name: Bloom Goes the Dynamite
t.text: Nefer leads with powerful Lunar-Bloom Charged Attacks, while Columbina enables Lunar-Bloom, Lauma boosts reaction damage, and Sucrose provides grouping and buffs.

t.name: Moon Over Matter
t.text: Zibai leads Geo damage while Columbina supplies Hydro and enables Lunar Crystallize. Linnea and Illuga support the reaction with buffs and damage.

t.name: MOONIMUM WAGE
t.text: Columbina enables Lunar Charged, Fischl supplies Electro, Aino adds Hydro, and Sucrose groups enemies while boosting reaction damage.

seo.about: Columbina is a Hydro support/sub DPS who enables and buffs Lunar Reactions. She provides long lasting off field Hydro while boosting team reaction damage.

w.name: Lightbearing Moonshard
w.text: Provides 88.2% CRIT DMG and, at R1, grants 20% DEF and 64% Lunar-Crystallize DMG for 5 seconds after using an Elemental Skill. Zibai’s signature weapon and best-in-slot choice, directly boosting her DEF scaling and reaction damage.

w.name: Uraku Misugiri
w.text: Provides 88.2% CRIT DMG and, at R1, grants 20% DEF and 24% Elemental Skill DMG, doubled to 40% DEF and 48% Skill DMG after nearby Geo damage. Zibai’s second-best weapon, offering excellent CRIT and DEF, but less Lunar-Crystallize damage than her signature.

w.name: Flute of Ezpitzal
w.text: Provides 69% DEF and, at R5, grants an additional 32% DEF for 15 seconds after using an Elemental Skill. Zibai’s best craftable F2P weapon, offering excellent DEF for her Lunar-Crystallize damage.

w.name: Harbinger of Dawn
w.text: Strong CRIT option while HP stays above 90%. A shielder or reliable healing helps maintain its passive.

a.text: Provides 80 EM and up to 30% CRIT Rate when Lunar Reactions trigger at Ascendant Gleam. Also grants the team a 10% Lunar Reaction DMG Bonus. Zibai’s best-in-slot artifact set, maximizing her Lunar-Crystallize damage while buffing the team.

Provides 30% DEF and up to 24% additional DEF and 24% Geo DMG Bonus at max stacks. A solid temporary set for Zibai, boosting her DEF scaling, but significantly weaker than Night of the Sky’s Unveiling for Lunar-Crystallize damage.

Provides 80 EM and 35% Charged Attack DMG for Catalyst and Bow users. Since Zibai uses a sword, the 4-piece bonus does not activate. The 2-piece EM bonus is usable, but this is not a recommended full set for her.

t.name: Crater Expectations
t.text: Zibai leads on-field Lunar-Crystallize damage, Columbina provides off-field Hydro and Lunar buffs, Linnea adds Geo RES shred, healing, and EM buffs, and Illuga boosts Geo and Lunar-Crystallize damage.

t.name: Geo Force One
t.text: Zibai leads on-field Lunar-Crystallize damage, Columbina provides off-field Hydro and Lunar buffs, Illuga boosts Geo and Lunar-Crystallize damage, and Gorou adds DEF and Geo DMG buffs.

t.name: OSMANTHUS WHINES
t.text: Zibai leads on-field Lunar-Crystallize damage, Columbina provides off-field Hydro and Lunar buffs, Illuga boosts Geo and Lunar-Crystallize damage, and Zhongli provides shielding and universal RES shred.

t.name: Columbina at Home
t.text: Zibai leads on-field Lunar-Crystallize damage, Illuga provides major Geo and Lunar reaction buffs, Aino supplies off-field Hydro application, and Gorou boosts DEF and Geo damage.

seo.about: Zibai is a Geo on-field DPS focused on Lunar-Crystallize, offering strong sustained damage but favoring dedicated team setups. Also, she's a horse.
stats: CRIT Rate: 40–50% with Night of the Sky’s Unveiling

seo.about: Kinich is a 5★ Dendro on-field DPS who builds Nightsoul points to fire powerful Scalespiker Cannons. Burning and Burgeon help him generate points faster and maximize his damage.

w.name: Angelos' Heptades
w.text: Angelos' Heptades is Nicole's BiS because its massive Base ATK and ATK% maximize her team buffs while providing additional DMG bonuses and Energy restoration.

w.name: Starcaller's Watch
w.text: Shield-oriented passive suits her play pattern, but the substat is not ATK%.

w.name: Skyward Atlas
w.text: Same high base ATK plus ATK% substat; its ATK-boosting proc adds a little more toward the 4000 threshold.

w.name: Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers
w.text: Zero-investment pick: the swap proc hands the next character 48% ATK.

w.name: Oathsworn Eye
w.text: Provides ATK as its secondary stat and boosts Energy Recharge after using her Skill. Useful when Burst uptime is difficult.

w.name: Flowing Purity
w.text: A craftable ATK catalyst that gains Elemental DMG after Skill use. A healer helps clear its Bond of Life effect.

w.name: Favonius Codex
w.text: Particles for the whole team lower everyone else's ER needs.

a.text: Celestial Gift is Nicole's BiS because its 4-piece bonus provides a 20% Pyro DMG Bonus, upgraded to 40% Pyro and 40% active-element DMG Bonus with Hexerei: Secret Rite active, greatly amplifying team damage.
Noblesse Oblige boosts Nicole's Burst damage and provides a 20% teamwide ATK buff, making it a strong alternative support set.

t.name: Hot & Bothered
t.text: Varka drives Anemo damage, Prune amplifies Anemo, Durin provides off-field Pyro damage, and Nicole boosts team damage through buffs and Hexerei synergy.

t.name: Melt Down
t.text: Lohen drives Cryo damage and triggers Melt, Durin provides off-field Pyro damage, Citlali enables Melt and shreds Pyro RES, and Nicole buffs both damage dealers.

t.name: PawPixls main
t.text: Wanderer drives Anemo damage, Faruzan amplifies Anemo, Durin provides off-field Pyro damage and RES shred, and Nicole boosts team damage through buffs and Hexerei synergy.

t.name: Budget Cuts
t.text: Razor and Fischl provide Electro damage while Nicole supplies Pyro and buffs. Chevreuse supports Overloaded teams with healing and resistance reduction.

seo.about: Nicole is a versatile support who empowers Hexerei teams with strong buffs and utility while requiring very little field time. She also breathes new life into older ATK-scaling carries.

sets: A Day Carved From Rising Winds

w.name: Polar Star
w.text: Polar Star provides CRIT Rate, Skill and Burst DMG, and up to 48% ATK, perfectly complementing Childe’s full rotation and Riptide damage.

w.name: Thundering Pulse
w.text: Thundering Pulse provides massive CRIT DMG and ATK, plus a Normal Attack bonus that works in Childe’s melee stance, making it a strong 5-star alternative to Polar Star.

w.name: Chain Breaker
w.text: Chain Breaker provides ATK% and additional ATK based on team composition, with bonus EM for Vaporize damage, making it a solid craftable F2P option for Childe.

w.name: The Viridescent Hunt
w.text: Viridescent Hunt provides CRIT Rate and groups enemies with its Cyclone, making Childe’s Riptide AoE damage more effective.

w.name: Blackcliff Warbow
w.text: Provides CRIT DMG and gains ATK after defeating enemies. Less reliable against bosses or single-target encounters.

a.text: Nymph’s Dream provides Hydro DMG and up to 25% ATK and 15% additional Hydro DMG, making it Childe’s best artifact set for maximizing his overall damage.
Heart of Depth provides 15% Hydro DMG and boosts Normal and Charged Attack damage by 30% after using Childe’s Skill, making it a strong set for his melee stance.

t.name: Ginger Snaps
t.text: Childe drives Hydro damage and enables Durin’s Vaporize hits, Durin provides off-field Pyro damage, Nicole buffs and shields the team, and Kazuha boosts damage and shreds RES.

t.name: Waterboarding
t.text: Childe drives on-field Hydro damage, Columbina buffs Lunar-Charged reactions, Ineffa provides off-field Electro and Lunar-Charged damage, and Citlali adds shielding and RES shred.

t.name: Childe, Please
t.text: Childe drives on-field Hydro damage, Furina provides off-field damage and buffs, Escoffier shreds Hydro RES and heals, and Citlali adds shielding and further Hydro RES shred.

t.name: Childe Support
t.text: Childe drives Hydro application, Xiangling deals off-field Pyro damage through Vaporize, Bennett provides ATK buffs and healing, and Sucrose groups enemies, boosts damage, and shreds RES.

seo.about: Tartaglia is a fast paced Hydro DPS who excels at reaction-driven teams and devastating AoE damage through Riptide. If you love chaos ginger energy, he's meant for you.

w.name: Tulaytullah's Remembrance
w.text: Provides CRIT DMG substat, Skill grants Normal Attack DMG and attack speed.

w.name: Cashflow Supervision
w.text: Provides 22.1% CRIT Rate, 16% ATK, and stacking Normal and Charged Attack DMG bonuses when HP changes, making it a strong 5 star alternative for Wanderer.

w.name: Skyward Atlas
w.text: High base ATK with ATK% substat.

w.name: Kagura's Verity
w.text: High CRIT DMG makes this a usable stat stick. Wanderer rarely builds enough Skill stacks to benefit fully from its passive.

w.name: Solar Pearl
w.text: Provides CRIT Rate. Skill or Burst hits boost Normal Attack damage, while Normal Attacks boost Skill and Burst damage.

w.name: The Widsith
w.text: substat. Random buff: ATK%, Anemo DMG, or Elemental Mastery.

w.name: Dodoco Tales
w.text: Its ATK% stat and Charged Attack buff reward weaving Normal and Charged Attacks together.

w.name: Mappa Mare
w.text: Craftable EM option. Triggering elemental reactions grants a general Elemental DMG Bonus, though its EM is less valuable for Wanderer.

a.text: Charged Attack hits raise attack speed and Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack damage. Its two-piece bonus gives Anemo DMG.
Provides ATK% and a chance for Normal Attack hits to trigger extra damage based on ATK. Performance can vary with latency.

t.name: PawPixL's Team
t.text: Wanderer handles on-field damage while Faruzan buffs Anemo damage. Nicole supplies support and Durin adds off-field Pyro pressure.

t.name: Nora is Cool
t.text: Wanderer drives reactions from the air while Columbina and Ineffa add off-field damage. Faruzan buffs his Anemo attacks.

t.name: Mile High Club
t.text: Furina contributes off-field Hydro and team damage buffs. Bennett heals and buffs ATK, while Faruzan boosts Wanderer’s Anemo damage.

t.name: Spirit Airlines
t.text: Wanderer triggers Xingqiu’s Burst with Normal Attacks. Bennett provides healing and ATK, while Faruzan boosts Anemo damage.

why.v:
DPS (Without Bennett): Desert Pavilion Chronicle, Tulaytullah's Remembrance, ATK%/Anemo DMG/CR
DPS (With Bennett): Desert Pavilion Chronicle, Tulaytullah's Remembrance, ATK%/Anemo DMG/CR

seo.about: Wanderer is a fast, mobile Anemo DPS who dominates from the air with rapid ranged attacks and flexible team options. As a totally unbiased Wanderer main, he’s best boy.

w.name: Crimson Moon's Semblance
w.text: Provides CRIT Rate, grants Bond of Life on a Charged Attack hit, and boosts her damage while Bond of Life is active.

w.name: Staff of Homa
w.text: Provides CRIT DMG and converts HP into ATK. A strong premium alternative for her Normal Attack damage.

w.name: Primordial Jade Winged-Spear
w.text: Stacks ATK and DMG on hit; great for sustained combos.

w.name: Staff of the Scarlet Sands
w.text: EM converts to ATK; boosts Charged Attack DMG for Vaporize / Melt.

w.name: Ballad of the Fjords
w.text: Provides CRIT Rate and grants Elemental Mastery with three different elements in the team, especially useful for Vaporize.

w.name: Deathmatch
w.text: substat; passive gives ATK or DEF based on foe count — budget consistency.

w.name: White Tassel
w.text: substat and passive boosts Normal Attack DMG; cheap for N3D/N5D combos.

a.text: Grants ATK and stacks a damage bonus whenever her Bond of Life changes, making it her strongest general set.
4pc boosts Normal Attack DMG based on ATK after Normal Attacks; strong for N3D/N5D but needs low ping.
Can excel in qualifying Moonsign teams, but is not a universal alternative to Fragment of Harmonic Whimsy.

t.name: Father Figures
t.text: Arlecchino leads with Pyro damage while Fischl adds off-field Electro. Mona offers brief Hydro application and a damage buff. Nicole adds support.

t.name: Heated Rivalry
t.text: Arlecchino drives Pyro damage, Citlali provides shielding and RES shred, Yelan and Xingqiu enable consistent Vaporize reactions and Hydro application.

t.name: Moonlighting
t.text: Arlecchino drives Pyro damage, Ineffa enables Lunar-Charged reactions, Columbina amplifies Lunar reactions, and Yelan provides Hydro application and off-field damage.

t.name: Workers' Compensation
t.text: Arlecchino drives Pyro damage, Xingqiu enables Vaporize, Bennett boosts ATK, and Sucrose provides EM buffs and RES shred.

seo.about: Arlecchino is a powerful Pyro DPS who excels at devastating Normal Attack damage and reaction-based teams. She hits hard, rewards aggressive play, and makes Father proud.
stats: Elemental Mastery: 100–150 for Vaporize or Melt

w.name: Bloodsoaked Ruins
w.text: Provides 22.1% CRIT Rate, boosts Lunar-Charged DMG by 36%, and grants 28% CRIT DMG plus Energy after triggering Lunar-Charged. Flins’s signature weapon and best-in-slot.

w.name: Staff of the Scarlet Sands
w.text: Provides 44.1% CRIT Rate and converts EM into bonus ATK, making it Flins’s second-best 5-star option for Lunar-Charged damage.

w.name: Tamayuratei no Ohanashi
w.text: Provides 30.6% Energy Recharge and increases ATK after triggering an Elemental Skill, helping Flins maintain Burst uptime and damage.

w.name: Prospector's Shovel
w.text: Provides 41.3% ATK and up to 48% Lunar-Charged DMG Bonus at R5, making it Flins’s best craftable F2P option.

a.text: Grants EM and extra CRIT Rate during Lunar reactions. The higher bonus depends on Moonsign level, making it ideal for Flins teams.
Provides 15% Electro DMG and 20% Lunar-Charged DMG, with Skill cooldown reduction. A strong alternative for Flins, especially in teams with Fischl.
Provides 18% ATK and 80 EM, offering a flexible alternative for boosting Flins’s ATK and reaction damage.

t.name: Thunder Down Under
t.text: Flins drives Lunar-Charged damage, Columbina buffs Lunar reactions, Sucrose boosts EM and shreds RES, and Ineffa adds off-field Electro and shielding.

t.name: Watt the Flins
t.text: Flins deals Lunar Charged damage while Aino supplies Hydro. Ineffa adds off field Electro damage and shielding, and Sucrose groups enemies and shares EM.

t.name: Birds of Prey
t.text: Flins leads the Lunar Charged damage while Columbina supports Lunar reactions. Ineffa adds shielding and Electro damage, and Fischl contributes Oz damage.

t.name: Low Current Balance
t.text: Flins drives Lunar Charged reactions with Aino’s Hydro application. Sucrose shares EM and groups enemies, while Fischl adds off field Electro damage.

seo.about: Flins is an Electro DPS who unleashes devastating Lunar Charged damage through his Elemental Bursts. He’s easy to play and hits hard, but his best performance depends on the right teammates.
cons: Damage drops without proper team synergy

w.name: Reliquary of Truth
w.text: Provides 88.2% CRIT DMG, 8% CRIT Rate, 120 EM, and up to 36% additional CRIT DMG at R1, making it Nefer’s signature and best-in-slot weapon.

w.name: Nightweaver's Looking Glass
w.text: Provides 265 EM and boosts Lunar-Bloom DMG by 40% at R1, making it Nefer’s second-best weapon behind Reliquary of Truth.

w.name: Dawning Frost
w.text: Provides 55.1% CRIT DMG and up to 216 EM at R1 after hitting with Charged Attacks and Elemental Skills, making it a strong 4-star option for Nefer

w.name: Blackmarrow Lantern
w.text: Offers Elemental Mastery and reaction bonuses. Check its acquisition source before listing it as a craftable F2P recommendation.

a.text: Provides 80 EM and up to 30% CRIT Rate, while increasing teamwide Lunar Reaction DMG by 10%. Nefer’s best-in-slot set for Lunar-Bloom teams.
Provides 80 EM and up to 150 additional EM or 28% ATK, boosting Nefer’s Lunar-Bloom and reaction damage.
Provides 160 EM, boosting Nefer’s Lunar-Bloom damage and reaction scaling. A solid transitional option while farming her 4-piece set.

t.name: Petal to the Meta
t.text: Nefer drives Lunar-Bloom damage, Lauma provides major Lunar-Bloom buffs and Dendro RES shred, Nahida boosts EM, and Columbina supplies off-field Hydro and Lunar-Bloom buffs.

t.name: Petty Petals
t.text: Nefer drives Lunar-Bloom damage while Columbina supplies Hydro and reaction buffs. Kokomi adds healing and Hydro application, and Nahida shares EM.

t.name: Bloom With a View
t.text: Nefer drives Lunar-Bloom damage, Columbina provides Hydro and Lunar buffs, Lauma amplifies Lunar-Bloom, and Ineffa adds shielding, off-field damage, and extra reaction support.

t.name: Broke But Blooming
t.text: Nefer drives Lunar-Bloom damage, Aino provides Hydro application and Lunar buffs, Kirara supplies Dendro application and shielding, and Sucrose boosts EM.

why.v: Sustain: Optional depending on the team. Nefer's dash-heavy gameplay offers substantial protection, but a healer or shielder can make rotations more comfortable.. Lauma C1 makes Nefer teams much more comfortable.

seo.about: Nefer is a Dendro DPS who specializes in powerful Lunar Bloom damage. She thrives in dedicated teams and scales heavily with Elemental Mastery.

a.text: Provides 36% ATK, making it a solid transitional set for boosting Sandrone’s personal damage.

t.name: Marionette Mayhem
t.text: Sandrone drives on-field Stellar-Conduct damage, Mitya provides off-field Electro and reaction damage, Odette adds off-field Cryo and Stellar damage buffs, and Nicole provides ATK buffs and shielding.

t.name: The Puppet Protocol
t.text: Sandrone leads the damage while Yae Miko adds off-field Electro. Odette supports Stellar reactions and Qiqi provides healing.

t.name: Strings Attached
t.text: Sandrone leads on-field Stellar-Conduct damage, Yae provides off-field Electro and reaction damage, Escoffier adds Cryo application and RES shred, and Sucrose boosts EM while reducing enemy resistance with Viridescent Venerer.

t.name: Spare Parts Squad
t.text: Sandrone leads on-field Stellar-Conduct damage, Beidou provides off-field Electro and C6 reaction buffs, Qiqi supplies healing, Cryo application, and Stellar-Conduct buffs, while Sucrose shares EM and shreds resistance with Viridescent Venerer.

seo.about: Sandrone is an on-field DPS specializing in consistent damage and Stellar Conduct reactions, rewarding teams built around her unique mechanics.

w.text: Offers high Elemental Mastery for Melt teams and useful team buffs, but weaker personal stats than dedicated CRIT weapons.

w.name: Ballad of the Boundless Blue
w.text: Provides 30.6% Energy Recharge and, at R5, grants up to 48% Normal Attack DMG and 36% Charged Attack DMG after hitting enemies. A solid F2P option for Wriothesley, especially if he needs extra Energy Recharge.

w.name: Mappa Mare
w.text: Craftable Elemental Mastery choice; triggering Melt reliably procs its Elemental DMG Bonus.

t.text: Wriothesley drives on-field Melt damage, Durin provides Pyro application, Nicole delivers teamwide ATK buffs, and Xilonen shreds Cryo/Pyro RES while boosting damage.

Boosts Elemental Skill damage significantly, making it a strong alternative for Heizou's Skill-focused DPS build, especially in quickswap teams.

t.name: The Final Suspect
t.text: Faruzan amplifies Heizou's Anemo damage while Yelan provides powerful off-field damage and Bennett boosts ATK and provides healing. A strong hypercarry team built around maximizing Heizou's powerful Skill hits.

t.name: Anemo Authority
t.text: Xianyun enables powerful Plunging Attacks while boosting their damage, Furina provides off-field Hydro damage and a teamwide DMG bonus, and Bennett adds healing and ATK buffs. A strong plunge-focused Heizou DPS team.

t.name: Anemo-nomicon
t.text: Fischl and Ineffa provide consistent off-field Electro damage while Xingqiu adds Hydro application and defensive utility. Heizou drives powerful Electro-Charged reactions while keeping the team swirling.

t.name: CSI: Mondstadt
t.text: Xingqiu and Xiangling provide powerful off-field Hydro and Pyro damage while Bennett supplies healing and ATK buffs. Heizou drives constant reactions and Swirls, amplifying the team's damage with Viridescent Venerer.

EM DPS: Viridescent Venerer, Skyward Atlas, EM/EM/EM (Substats prioritize EM and enough ER to burst comfortably)
Anemo Main DPS: Viridescent Venerer, A Thousand Floating Dreams, ATK%/Anemo DMG/CR (Substats: CR/CD > ATK% > ER > EM) Swirl DMG Does NOT scale with talent levels.

seo.about: Heizou is an Anemo catalyst DPS who combines rapid attacks with devastating Elemental Skill punches. He excels as an on-field reaction driver or a Skill-focused damage dealer.

t.name: Melt & Mayhem
t.text: Rosaria and Citlali provide Cryo application for Mavuika's Melt reactions. Bennett adds healing, ATK buffs, and Pyro Resonance.

t.text: Rosaria provides additional Cryo damage and CRIT Rate sharing while Furina supplies Hydro application and damage buffs. Escoffier provides healing and Cryo/Hydro RES reduction.

t.name: Ghosts & Vapors
t.text: Xingqiu enables Vaporize while Rosaria adds Cryo application for occasional Melt reactions. Zhongli provides shielding and resistance reduction.

t.name: Budget Blizzard
t.text: Rosaria and Kaeya provide consistent Cryo damage and application while Xiangling triggers Reverse Melt. Bennett supplies healing, ATK buffs, and energy support.

Support: Noblesse Oblige, Favonius Lance, ATK%/Cryo DMG/CR. May also use Emblem of Severed Fates artifact set to meet ER needs.

seo.about: Rosaria is a Cryo polearm Sub-DPS who provides consistent off-field Cryo damage, strong Burst support, and a valuable CRIT Rate buff for the team. She shares up to 15% CRIT Rate with her passive.

w.name: Favonius Codex
w.text: Provides Energy Recharge and generates neutral particles when Charlotte lands CRIT hits. Helps charge her Burst and supports the team.

w.name: Kagura's Verity
w.text: A personal damage option that boosts Elemental Skill damage after Skill use. Only consider it when Charlotte has enough Energy Recharge.

w.name: Prototype Amber
w.text: Restores Energy after her Burst and heals the entire team. Excellent for improving Charlotte’s healing and Burst consistency.

w.name: Flowing Purity
w.text: Offers ATK and Elemental DMG bonuses through its Bond of Life mechanic. A niche offensive option rather than a healing support weapon.

w.name: Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers
w.text: Gives a large ATK buff to the next character you switch to. Use only if Charlotte can meet her Energy needs without an ER weapon.

w.name: Oathsworn Eye
w.text: Its ATK stat supports her healing, while using her Skill grants Energy Recharge. Useful if you own this limited event catalyst.

a.text: Gives the party 20% ATK after Charlotte uses her Burst. A good choice when she can Burst consistently.
Buffs team ATK after Charlotte’s Skill hits. Her held Skill helps maintain the buff, but uptime can be awkward.
Converts part of Charlotte’s healing into extra damage. A useful option when another teammate already provides ATK buffs.

t.name: Frozen Verdict
t.text: Charlotte provides teamwide healing and Freeze utility while Furina buffs the team's damage. Kazuha provides grouping and resistance reduction.

t.name: Frozen Assets
t.text: Skirk deals Cryo damage while Furina buffs the team. Escoffier adds damage, healing, and resistance reduction. Charlotte adds more Cryo and extra healing.

t.name: Shiver Me Timbers
t.text: Charlotte supplies healing and Cryo Resonance while Furina provides Hydro application and damage buffs. Kazuha groups enemies and shreds resistance.

t.name: Budget Blizzard
t.text: An accessible Freeze team with Kaeya as the on-field damage dealer. Xingqiu provides Hydro application, Sucrose offers grouping and buffs, and Charlotte keeps everyone healthy.

seo.about: Charlotte is a Cryo catalyst healer who provides powerful teamwide healing, off-field Cryo application, and support utility. She excels in Freeze teams and works particularly well alongside Furina.

w.name: Redhorn Stonethresher
w.text: Redhorn Stonethresher is Noelle's best-in-slot DPS weapon, providing massive CRIT DMG, increased DEF, and bonus Normal and Charged Attack damage that perfectly synergize with her C6 scaling.

w.name: Serpent Spine
w.text: Serpent Spine is an excellent 4-star alternative, offering valuable CRIT Rate and stacking DMG bonuses that significantly boost Noelle's overall damage.

w.name: Skyward Pride
w.text: Skyward Pride provides valuable Energy Recharge for Burst uptime, along with increased damage and additional vacuum blade damage after using her Burst.

w.name: Favonius Greatsword
w.text: Favonius Greatsword provides Energy Recharge and generates extra particles through CRIT hits, helping Noelle and her teammates maintain consistent Burst uptime.

a.text: 4pc Husk of Opulent Dreams is Noelle's best overall artifact set, providing DEF% and Geo DMG bonuses that directly enhance her C6 damage, shielding, and healing.

4pc Marechaussee Hunter is a strong alternative when paired with Furina, providing up to 36% CRIT Rate through HP fluctuations. This allows Noelle to prioritize CRIT DMG while maintaining excellent damage output.
4pc Archaic Petra makes Noelle a team support option, granting a 35% Elemental DMG Bonus to the element corresponding to the Crystallize shard she collects, benefiting elemental-focused teammates.

t.name: Geo Moonrise
t.text: Noelle leads with Geo damage and healing. Columbina supports Lunar reactions, Ineffa adds off-field Electro damage, and Linnea provides Geo support.

t.name: Hopeless Impact
t.text: Noelle leads as the on-field DPS, while Columbina enables Lunar-Crystallize reactions. Linnea provides Geo RES shred and off-field damage, while Illuga boosts Noelle's Geo damage and CRIT potential for stronger overall output.

t.name: Heavenly Deluge
t.text: Noelle drives the team with Geo damage and healing, while Furina buffs overall damage, Columbina boosts Lunar reactions, and Linnea provides Geo RES shred and off-field damage.

t.name: Big Boom
t.text: Noelle leads with Geo damage while Durin provides off-field Pyro damage, Nicole boosts team performance through Hexerei synergy, and Xilonen adds buffs and resistance shred.

seo.about: Noelle combines strong Geo AoE damage with shielding and healing. At C6, she becomes a powerful DEF-scaling Main DPS with excellent survivability.

w.name: Kagura's Verity
w.text: Yae's signature weapon, providing massive CRIT DMG and stacking Elemental Skill DMG bonuses that perfectly complement her Sesshou Sakura.

w.name: Reliquary of Truth
w.text: Provides substantial CRIT DMG, additional CRIT Rate, and Elemental Mastery, making it a powerful alternative across multiple builds.

w.name: The Widsith
w.text: Offers valuable CRIT DMG and powerful random buffs, making it one of Yae's strongest 4-star damage options.

w.name: Echoes of the Heart
w.text: A strong craftable option providing ATK, Elemental Mastery, and Stellar-Conduct DMG bonuses. Particularly effective in teams with reliable reaction uptime.

w.name: Flowing Purity
w.text: Craftable ATK% catalyst that can grant Elemental DMG after using a Skill, provided its Bond of Life is cleared with healing.

w.name: Oathsworn Eye
w.text: Event catalyst with ATK% and extra Energy Recharge after using her Skill. Helpful for Burst uptime.

a.text: Provides ATK%, Stellar-Conduct DMG, and additional CRIT Rate against affected enemies. Her strongest personal damage set in Stellar-Conduct teams.

t.name: Three Geniuses & Qiqi
t.text: Yae and Sandrone provide off-field Electro damage and coordinated attacks, while Nicole buffs the team and Qiqi keeps everyone alive. A flexible, sustained-damage team with plenty of off-field pressure.

t.name: Sparkle Prince
t.text: Yae provides off-field Electro damage while Mitya and Odette drive the team’s Lunar reactions. Qiqi adds healing and sustain, keeping the team comfortable through extended fights.

t.name: I’m Aggravated
t.text: Alhaitham drives on-field Dendro damage while Yae triggers Aggravate with consistent Electro application. Nahida boosts Dendro damage and EM, while Baizhu provides healing and additional reaction support.

t.name: Resting Ei Face
t.text: Raiden handles on-field damage while Yae adds off-field Electro. Nicole shields and buffs ATK, and Chevreuse strengthens Pyro and Electro damage through Overloaded.

seo.about: Yae Miko delivers consistent off-field Electro damage with strong reaction synergy. Her versatility makes her a great fit for Stellar-Conduct and Aggravate teams.

w.name: Hymn of the Maelstrom
w.text: Hymn of the Maelstrom is Vodyanitsa's signature weapon, offering substantial HP scaling, Healing Bonus, and team ATK buffs. Its passive synergizes especially well with Frozen and Stellar Swirl teams.

w.name: Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers
w.text: Thrilling Tales offers HP% and a powerful team ATK buff, making it an excellent F2P support option. Particularly valuable in teams with ATK-scaling DPS characters.

w.name: Jadefall's Splendor
w.text: Jadefall's Splendor offers substantial HP% and additional Energy restoration, making it a solid stat stick for Vodyanitsa. However, it provides limited team utility compared to her signature weapon or Thrilling Tales.

w.name: Prototype Amber
w.text: Prototype Amber provides substantial HP%, Energy restoration, and teamwide healing. An excellent craftable option that improves Vodyanitsa's consistency and provides additional utility in Furina teams.

w.name: Ash-Graven Drinking Horn
w.text: Event option with an HP stat and an AoE hit equal to 40% of Max HP.

a.text: Tenacity is Vodyanitsa's premier support set for ATK-scaling teams, offering additional HP and consistent teamwide ATK buffs. An excellent choice for Skirk and Vesna compositions.

For Neuvillette and Mizuki teams, consider 2-piece Tenacity + 2-piece Vourukasha's Glow instead of TotM 4-Piece. The additional HP is more valuable when the team's damage doesn't benefit from ATK buffs.
Tenacity is Vodyanitsa's premier support set for ATK-scaling teams, offering additional HP and consistent teamwide ATK buffs. An excellent choice for Skirk and Vesna compositions.

t.name: Siren's Symphony
t.text: Vodyanitsa provides healing, Anemo RES Shred, and damage buffs to amplify Vesna's Stellar Swirl damage. Double Cryo helps maintain consistent reactions while keeping Vesna comfortable on-field.

t.name: Frozen Melodies
t.text: Vodyanitsa provides healing, RES Shred, and damage buffs to amplify Skirk's Cryo damage. Furina and Escoffier add powerful damage buffs and Cryo/Hydro synergy for a strong Freeze team.

t.name: Mermaid Mayhem
t.text: Vodyanitsa provides Hydro RES Shred, healing, and additional damage buffs to amplify Neuvillette's Hydro damage. Furina adds substantial DMG buffs and off-field damage, while Xilonen further boosts damage through RES Shred and healing.

t.name: Bubble Trouble
t.text: Vodyanitsa provides healing, RES Shred, and Stellar Swirl damage buffs, while Cryo Traveler enables consistent reactions. Diona adds shielding, healing, and additional Cryo application, allowing Mizuki to focus on driving Stellar Swirl damage.

seo.about: Vodyanitsa is a versatile Hydro support who provides strong team utility, consistent Hydro application, and valuable damage buffs. She fits comfortably into a variety of reaction-focused teams.

w.name: Nightweaver's Looking Glass
w.text: Provides 265 EM, with an additional 120 EM from its passive. Grants the entire team +120% Bloom DMG, +80% Hyperbloom/Burgeon DMG, and +40% Lunar-Bloom DMG, making it Lauma's best-in-slot signature.

w.name: Etherlight Spindlelute
w.text: Provides 45.9% Energy Recharge and 200 EM for 20s after using an Elemental Skill, making it an excellent F2P option that balances Lauma's Energy needs with her Lunar-Bloom scaling.

w.name: A Thousand Floating Dreams
w.text: Provides 265 EM, with up to 96 additional EM or 30% Elemental DMG Bonus depending on team composition. Also grants nearby teammates 40 EM, making it an excellent alternative for boosting Lauma's Lunar-Bloom damage and team reaction output.

w.name: Blackmarrow Lantern
w.text: Provides 221 EM, increases Bloom DMG by 96% and Lunar-Bloom DMG by 24%, with an additional 24% Lunar-Bloom DMG under Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam. An excellent F2P option for maximizing Lauma's reaction damage.

a.text: Grants 20% Energy Recharge from its 2-piece bonus. The 4-piece effect provides 60 EM (120 EM at Ascendant Gleam) to the entire team and increases Lunar Reaction DMG by 10% per different Gleaming Moon effect. Lauma's best artifact set for supporting Lunar-Bloom teams.

Provides 15% Dendro DMG Bonus and reduces enemies' Dendro RES by 30% for 8s after Lauma's Skill or Burst hits, making it a strong support option for boosting team Dendro damage, particularly when no other teammate carries the set.

Provides 160 Elemental Mastery, making this an excellent alternative for maximizing Lauma's Lunar-Bloom buffs and reaction damage. A strong, flexible combination when farming a dedicated 4-piece set isn't practical.

t.name: Celestial Bloom
t.text: Nefer's Lunar-Bloom team, combining Columbina's Hydro application with Lauma and Nahida's powerful reaction buffs, EM sharing, and Dendro RES reduction. Run Deepwood on Nahida and Silken Moon on Lauma or Columbina. Lacks dedicated healing.

t.name: Mossy Water
t.text: Neuvillette and Furina provide Hydro damage, while Lauma adds Dendro and reaction support. Ineffa shields and triggers Hyperbloom and Lunar-Charged damage.

t.name: Leaf It Alone
t.text: Alhaitham deals on-field Dendro damage, Xingqiu applies Hydro, and Kuki heals while triggering Hyperbloom. Lauma adds Dendro and reaction support.

t.name: Four-Star Garden
t.text: Lauma supplies Dendro and buffs, Aino and Xingqiu apply Hydro, and Kuki heals and triggers Hyperbloom. Accessible teammates support a premium Lauma core.

seo.about: Lauma is a powerful Dendro support specializing in Lunar-Bloom, offering strong reaction buffs, excellent team synergy, and solid off-field utility.

w.name: Fractured Halo
w.text: Provides valuable CRIT stats and boosts Ineffa's damage, making it a strong option for improving her personal DPS and overall Lunar-Charged damage output.

w.name: Staff of the Scarlet Sands
w.text: Provides high CRIT Rate and converts Elemental Mastery into additional ATK, boosting Ineffa's personal damage while benefiting her reaction-focused builds.

w.name: Prospector's Shovel
w.text: Provides ATK and a Lunar Charged damage bonus under its passive conditions. A useful accessible option for her reaction damage.

w.name: "The Catch"
w.text: Provides Energy Recharge and increases Elemental Burst damage and CRIT Rate, helping Ineffa maintain Burst uptime and improve her Burst damage.

a.text: Boosts Elemental Mastery and Lunar reaction damage, making it an excellent set for maximizing Ineffa's Lunar-Charged damage and team synergy.
Provides Elemental Mastery and increases Elemental Energy, making it a useful alternative for supporting Ineffa's Lunar reaction damage and team performance.
Provides Elemental Mastery and an additional ATK or EM bonus based on team composition, boosting Ineffa's reaction damage and overall DPS.

t.name: Moonfall
t.text: Flins drives Lunar Charged damage while Columbina supports Lunar reactions. Ineffa adds Electro damage and shielding, and Sucrose groups enemies.

t.name: Storm Surge
t.text: Neuvillette drives Hydro damage while Furina adds buffs and off field Hydro. Ineffa contributes Electro and shielding, while Xilonen heals and shreds resistance.

t.name: Electric Bubbles
t.text: Clorinde drives Electro damage, Furina enables Hydro reactions and buffs damage, Ineffa provides shielding and Electro, and Xilonen heals and shreds resistance.

t.name: Short Circuit
t.text: Ifa drives reactions with Aino’s Hydro and Ororon’s Electro. Ineffa adds shielding, Electro damage and Lunar Charged support.

seo.about: Ineffa is a versatile off-field Electro DPS and Lunar-Charged enabler who provides shielding, strong reaction damage, and valuable team support.
cons: DMG potential depends on team synergy.

w.text: Its high Base ATK strengthens Bennett’s Burst buff. The Physical DMG stat has little value for a support build.

w.text: Provides high Base ATK for a stronger team buff, while Energy Recharge helps Bennett maintain consistent Burst uptime.

w.name: Favonius Sword
w.text: Provides Energy Recharge and generates extra particles through CRIT hits, helping Bennett and his teammates maintain consistent Burst uptime.

w.name: Sapwood Blade
w.text: Provides high Base ATK and Energy Recharge, making it an excellent F2P option for strengthening Bennett's ATK buff while maintaining Burst uptime.

a.text: Increases Elemental Burst damage and provides a 20% teamwide ATK buff after using Bennett's Burst, making it his best overall support set.

a.text: Can provide a small Elemental DMG bonus after Bennett triggers a reaction, but lacks the full Natlan Nightsoul bonus.

t.name: Phoenix Dive
t.text: Gaming delivers powerful Pyro plunging attacks, supported by Bennett's ATK buff, Furina's damage bonus, and Xianyun's plunging support and healing.

t.name: Raiden Hypercarry
t.text: Raiden Shogun deals on-field Electro damage while Sara and Bennett provide ATK buffs. Kazuha groups enemies and reduces Electro RES.

t.name: Crimson Reign
t.text: Bennett boosts Arlecchino's ATK while Yelan provides off-field Hydro damage for Vaporize. Kazuha adds crowd control and Pyro resistance reduction.

t.name: Crimson Tide
t.text: Tartaglia enables powerful Vaporize reactions with Xiangling's Pyronado. Bennett provides ATK buffs and healing, while Kazuha boosts elemental damage and groups enemies.

why.v: Note: Remember that artifact ATK% and flat ATK do not increase his team attack buff and that scales exclusively off his Base ATK, which comes entirely from his character level and weapon! ATK%/Crit are only if you want his personal DMG higher.

seo.about: Bennett is a powerful support who provides massive ATK buffs, reliable healing, and Pyro application. He's one of the most versatile supports in the game.

Provides a 20% teamwide ATK buff after using Iansan's Burst, further boosting her support capabilities and strengthening ATK-scaling DPS teammates.

t.name: Overload Express
t.text: Varesa delivers powerful plunge damage while Mavuika adds Pyro damage and Nightsoul support. Chevreuse provides Overload buffs and resistance reduction, while Iansan boosts team ATK.

t.name: Ashes to Ashes
t.text: Mavuika leads the damage while Iansan buffs ATK and supports healing. Ororon adds off field Electro and Chevreuse boosts the Overloaded team.

t.name: Gravity? Never Heard of Her
t.text: Varesa takes advantage of Xianyun's plunge buffs and Iansan's ATK support, while Furina provides a powerful teamwide damage bonus. Excellent synergy with Varesa's highly mobile playstyle.

t.name: Four-Star Fitness
t.text: Gaming delivers powerful Pyro plunges and Vaporize damage with Xingqiu's Hydro application. Iansan and Bennett provide ATK buffs, while Bennett also supplies additional healing.

seo.about: Iansan is an Electro support who provides powerful ATK buffs, healing, and off-field utility. She excels alongside mobile DPS characters who can maintain her Nightsoul buffs.
