w.name: Starcaller's Watch
w.text: Provides substantial Elemental Mastery to strengthen Citlali’s shield and reactions, while granting the active character a 28% DMG Bonus after she creates a shield. Her signature weapon and best-in-slot option.

w.name: Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers
w.text: Provides a powerful 48% ATK boost to your next active character, making it an excellent F2P support option for ATK-scaling DPS teams.

w.name: Etherlight Spindlelute
w.text: A strong alternative for improving Citlali's Energy Recharge and Burst uptime, helping her maintain consistent support and off-field Cryo application.

w.name: Sacrificial Fragments
w.text: Provides Elemental Mastery and a chance to reset her Skill cooldown. Offers flexibility, but its extra Skill use is often unnecessary.

names: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City
a.text: Citlali's best support artifact set, boosting team damage through Elemental DMG bonuses when triggering relevant reactions. Excellent for supporting Pyro and Hydro DPS characters.
Provides a teamwide 20% ATK boost when Citlali's off-field damage triggers its passive, making it a solid support option for ATK-scaling DPS teams.
Provides a 20% teamwide ATK boost after Citlali uses her Elemental Burst, making it a solid support option for ATK-scaling DPS teams.

t.name: Glacial Reign
t.text: Skirk deals Cryo damage, Furina provides Hydro and team buffs, and Escoffier heals while reducing Cryo and Hydro resistance. Citlali adds shielding and Scroll buffs.

t.name: Bloodmoon
t.text: Arlecchino combines Pyro damage with Vaporize and occasional Melt reactions. Yelan provides Hydro application, Citlali adds shielding and resistance reduction, and Bennett boosts Arlecchino's ATK.

t.name: Blazing Frost
t.text: Mavuika delivers powerful Pyro damage and triggers Melt with Citlali's Cryo application. Citlali and Xilonen provide resistance reduction and damage buffs, while Bennett supplies a massive ATK buff and healing.

t.name: Skyfire
t.text: Chasca benefits from Citlali's shielding and Pyro/Hydro resistance reduction, while Furina contributes off-field Hydro damage and a teamwide damage bonus. Bennett provides healing and ATK buffs.

seo.about: Citlali is a powerful Cryo support who provides shielding, off-field Cryo application, and Pyro and Hydro RES reduction to boost team damage.

sets: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

w.name: A Thousand Floating Dreams
w.text: Provides Elemental Mastery to boost Sucrose's Swirl damage and reaction support, while its passive grants additional EM or Elemental DMG bonuses based on teammates' elements. A strong option for maximizing her reaction-focused support.

w.name: Sunny Morning Sleep-In
w.text: Provides Elemental Mastery and boosts Swirl damage, making it an excellent weapon for maximizing Sucrose's reaction damage and team support.

w.name: Sacrificial Fragments
w.text: Provides Elemental Mastery and a chance to reset her Skill cooldown when it damages enemies, enabling extra Swirls.

w.name: Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers
w.text: Provides a powerful 48% ATK boost to the next character switched in, making Sucrose an excellent F2P buffer for ATK-scaling DPS teams.

w.name: Hakushin Ring
w.text: Provides Energy Recharge and grants an Elemental DMG Bonus to elements involved when Sucrose triggers an Electro reaction.

w.name: Magic Guide
w.text: Provides Elemental Mastery and increases damage against enemies affected by Hydro or Electro. A budget Swirl option.

a.text: Sucrose's best artifact set, increasing Swirl damage by 60% and reducing enemies' RES to the element Swirled by 40%. Essential for reaction-focused teams.
Provides Elemental Mastery and boosts the entire team's EM after triggering an elemental reaction. A solid F2P option for reaction-focused teams.
Boosts the team's ATK by 20% after Sucrose uses her Elemental Burst. A situational support option for ATK-scaling DPS teams.

t.name: Lunar-Charged Team #1
t.text: Sucrose drives Swirls while Xingqiu applies Hydro and Fischl supplies Electro. Ineffa adds Electro support and helps enable Lunar-Charged damage.

t.name: Vaporization Team
t.text: Sucrose groups enemies and shreds Pyro RES while Klee delivers explosive damage. Furina provides Hydro application and a powerful damage buff, while Bennett boosts ATK and provides healing.

t.name: Pyro Case Files
t.text: Sucrose provides grouping, EM sharing, and RES Shred while Nicole buffs the team and Mona boosts burst damage. Arlecchino leads with powerful Pyro damage, with Mona adding Hydro application for Vaporize opportunities.

t.name: Aggravate Academy
t.text: Sucrose provides Electro RES Shred and EM sharing while Keqing and Fischl trigger powerful Aggravate damage. Nahida supplies consistent Dendro application to keep reactions flowing.

seo.about: Anemo support who groups enemies, shares EM, and boosts reaction damage.

w.name: Jadefall's Splendor
w.text: Jadefall's Splendor boosts Baizhu's HP to strengthen his healing and shields while its passive restores energy after using his Burst, helping maintain consistent uptime.

w.name: Prototype Amber
w.text: Prototype Amber is an excellent F2P option, providing HP% to strengthen Baizhu's healing while restoring energy and regenerating HP for the entire team after using his Elemental Burst.

w.name: A Thousand Floating Dreams
w.text: A Thousand Floating Dreams provides Baizhu with substantial Elemental Mastery for reaction-based builds while also sharing an EM buff with teammates. It's particularly useful in Bloom teams, boosting reaction damage.

w.name: Everlasting Moonglow
w.text: Provides HP for stronger healing, but its passive offers limited value to an off-field Baizhu.

w.name: Favonius Codex
w.text: Favonius Codex provides valuable Energy Recharge to help Baizhu maintain consistent Burst uptime while generating extra particles for the team. Its passive requires Baizhu to land CRIT hits, so some CRIT Rate is needed to activate it reliably.

a.text: Reduces enemy Dendro RES by 30%. Best when no other teammate carries Deepwood Memories.
Song of Days Past boosts Baizhu's healing and converts it into additional team damage. A strong alternative when another teammate carries Deepwood.
Ocean-Hued Clam boosts Baizhu's healing and converts it into additional Physical AoE damage through its healing bubbles, providing extra damage without sacrificing his support role.

t.name: Nefer Nation
t.text: Nefer leads with powerful Lunar-Bloom damage, while Lauma and Columbina provide reaction support and Hydro application. Baizhu keeps the team healthy.

t.name: Dendro Dominance
t.text: Alhaitham drives Spread damage while Yae and Fischl provide consistent Electro application and off-field damage. Baizhu provides healing and reaction buffs.

t.name: Nilou's Garden
t.text: Nilou transforms Bloom reactions into devastating Bountiful Cores. Ayato supplies Hydro, Nahida provides Dendro application, and Baizhu keeps the team alive through Bloom self-damage.

t.name: Bloom & Doom
t.text: Nilou enables powerful Bountiful Core reactions, while Kaveh acts as the on-field Dendro driver. Xingqiu provides consistent Hydro application, and Baizhu offers healing, Dendro support, and protection against Bloom self-damage.

why.v: Baizhu prioritizes HP and Energy Recharge to maximize his healing and shielding. When used as an on-field Dendro driver, you can trade some HP for Elemental Mastery, aiming for around 500 EM.

seo.about: Baizhu is a Dendro healer who provides strong team-wide healing, interruption resistance, and Dendro application. He offers valuable defensive utility while supporting Dendro reactions.

w.name: Symphonist of Scents
w.text: Symphonist of Scents increases Mika's ATK and provides a teamwide ATK buff when he heals. It's a supportive option for ATK-scaling DPS teams, but Favonius Lance is generally better for his Energy needs

w.name: Favonius Lance
w.text: Provides Energy Recharge and generates extra particles for the team, helping Mika and his teammates maintain Burst uptime.

w.name: Dialogues of the Desert Sages
w.text: Dialogues of the Desert Sages boosts Mika's HP and restores Energy when he heals, improving his healing while helping maintain Burst uptime.

w.name: "The Catch"
w.text: An Energy Recharge stat stick that helps Burst uptime. Its offensive passive adds little value to a healer and Physical support.

a.text: Noblesse boosts Mika's Burst damage and grants the entire team a 20% ATK buff after using his Burst, making it excellent for supporting ATK-scaling DPS.
Ocean-Hued Clam converts Mika's healing into additional damage through its bubble effect, adding some personal damage while maintaining his healer role.
Maiden Beloved increases Mika's healing output, improving team survivability. However, it offers no team damage buffs, making Noblesse a stronger overall support option.

t.name: Frozen Thunder
t.text: Mika boosts Eula's Physical DMG and ATK SPD while providing consistent healing to support Furina's Fanfare stacks. Raiden enables Superconduct, provides Energy, and helps the team maximize Eula's devastating Burst damage.

t.name: Glacial Execution
t.text: Mika buffs Eula's Physical DMG and ATK SPD while healing the team. Fischl enables Superconduct, while Rosaria provides Cryo application and CRIT support.

t.name: Frozen Depths
t.text: Mika boosts Freminet's Physical DMG and ATK SPD while providing healing. Furina buffs team damage, while Fischl enables Superconduct and provides consistent off-field damage.

t.name: Mondstadt Wolfpack
t.text: Mika boosts Razor's Physical DMG and ATK SPD while providing healing. Fischl enables Superconduct, while Rosaria adds Cryo application and CRIT Rate support.

seo.about: Mika increases the active character's ATK SPD, boosts Physical DMG, and provides healing through his Elemental Burst. He's particularly valuable for Eula and other Physical DPS characters.
pros: Boosts Phy. DMG and ATK SPD.
Excellent for Eula and Physical DPS.
Easy to build with low investment.
cons: Weaker buffs against single targets at C0.

t.name: Melt Protocol
t.text: (Dark Mode) Lohen enables Durin to trigger powerful Melt reactions with his Burst, while Nicole and Citlali amplify the team's damage.

t.name: Father's Daycare
t.text: (LIght Mode) Frequent Overloaded reactions activate Chevreuse's buffs, while Durin and Fischl contribute off-field damage and additional RES reduction.

why.v: EM is valuable when Durin consistently triggers Melt or Vaporize. In Dark Mode aim for 100-200+ EM.

seo.about: Durin can switch between two forms. White Flame focuses on off field support and resistance reduction, while Dark Decay emphasizes personal damage and Melt or Vaporize reactions.

t.name: Hell's Kitchenette
t.text: Skirk deals on-field Cryo damage, Furina buffs with Hydro and Fanfare, while Escoffier shreds RES and heals, and Vodyanitsa adds buffs and sustain.

t.name: Grand MasterChef
t.text: Varka leads with Anemo damage while Prune supports him. Shenhe boosts Cryo hits and Escoffier heals, though this mixed team limits her full RES reduction.

t.name: Ice Guys Finish Last
t.text: Wriothesley can Melt with Xiangling while Bennett buffs ATK. Escoffier heals and adds Cryo damage, but this mixed team limits her full resistance reduction.

t.name: We Have Skirk at Home
t.text: Freminet deals Physical and Cryo damage while Xingqiu adds Hydro for Freeze. Rosaria helps with Cryo energy, and Escoffier heals and deals off field damage.

seo.about: Escoffier is a Cryo sub-DPS and healer who excels in Cryo/Hydro teams. She provides strong off field damage while shredding enemy RES. Also, she cooks ice.

w.text: Provides CRIT Rate, ATK, and increased Oz damage.

w.name: Skyward Harp
w.text: Boosts CRIT stats and Oz's damage.

w.name: The Stringless
w.text: Boosts Oz's damage and reaction potential.

w.name: Song of Stillness
w.text: Provides ATK and healing-triggered damage buffs.

a.text: Boosts Skill damage, massively increasing Oz's off-field damage.
Combines Skill damage from Golden Troupe with ATK from Gladiator’s Finale. A flexible placeholder while farming a full Golden Troupe set.
Provides Elemental Mastery and bonus ATK or EM after reactions. A usable Aggravate alternative, though Golden Troupe is usually stronger.

t.name: Outta Control
t.text: Clorinde drives the damage while Fischl and Mavuika trigger Overload. Chevreuse buffs the team and shreds enemy resistance.

t.name: Boom & Hex
t.text: Klee drives on-field damage, Fischl triggers Overload, Emilie boosts Burning damage, and Bennett provides healing and ATK buffs.

t.name: Electrolyte Overload
t.text: Cyno drives Aggravate while Fischl adds off field Electro damage. Nahida supports Quicken, and Baizhu heals. Cyno’s long rotations can limit Oz uptime.

t.name: Raiden at Home
t.text: Fischl and Beidou deal off-field Electro damage, Xingqiu enables Electro-Charged, and Sucrose drives reactions with Swirl.

why.v: Golden Troupe is her best off-field set, while Aggravate teams can benefit from more EM alongside ATK and CRIT. For on-field builds, consider alternatives since Golden Troupe's bonus is reduced.

seo.about: Fischl is an off-field Electro DPS who uses Oz for consistent damage and powerful reactions. She excels in reaction-focused teams and provides strong damage with minimal field time.

Off-field Swirl: Use Heart of the Furnace or Tenacity when another Anemo character drives Stellar Swirl. Cast Skill and Burst during their rotation.
CRIT Rate caution: Account for conditional CRIT bonuses from the artifact set, Cryo Resonance and Traveler passives before chasing more CRIT Rate.
Weapon investment: Exaiphanes Blade is free and often better than premium swords. You do not need to pull a five star weapon for this build.

seo.about: Cryo Traveler is a flexible Cryo DMG dealer who powers Stellar-Conduct & Stellar Swirl teams. They fight on the field in Stellar-Conduct & offer off-field DMG in Stellar Swirl. Their strongest attacks rely on building Frostglow stacks before using their Burst.

w.name: Absolution
w.text: Her signature gives CRIT DMG and increases damage whenever her Bond of Life rises. Best overall damage weapon.

w.name: Mistsplitter Reforged
w.text: Provides CRIT DMG and Elemental DMG bonuses that Clorinde can use during her Electro attacks. Passive stacks depend on rotation.

w.name: Haran Geppaku Futsu
w.text: Boosts Normal Attack damage and Elemental DMG, which suit her Skill attacks. Watch for excess CRIT Rate.

w.name: Light of Foliar Incision
w.text: Huge CRIT DMG with extra Normal Attack damage that scales with Elemental Mastery. Best in Aggravate teams with some EM.

w.name: The Black Sword
w.text: Boosts Normal Attack damage and gives CRIT Rate. Its healing can help her sustain. Avoid overcapping CRIT Rate.

w.name: Lion's Roar
w.text: Increases damage against enemies affected by Electro or Pyro. Needs reliable aura uptime. Higher refinements help.

w.name: Finale of the Deep
w.text: A strong craftable Sword that grants ATK and more ATK when its Bond of Life is cleared. Clorinde can clear the Bond with her own healing. Refinements improve its ATK bonus.

w.name: Calamity of Eshu
w.text: Boosts Normal Attack damage and CRIT Rate while protected by a shield. Requires a reliable shield and was event limited.

a.text: Bond of Life changes grant damage bonuses that Clorinde stacks quickly during her Skill.
Electro reactions shorten Skill cooldown, enabling longer reaction focused rotations.
Boosts her Normal Attack damage during Skill, making a good set while farming Whimsy.

t.name: Duelist’s Verdict
t.text: Nahida enables Quicken, Fischl adds Electro damage, and Kazuha shreds Electro resistance. Clorinde drives Aggravate.

t.name: Overload Authority
t.text: Chevreuse shreds Electro and Pyro resistance after Overload. Sara buffs Clorinde while Mavuika adds Pyro damage.

t.name: Charged Justice
t.text: Furina buffs team damage, Ororon adds Electro damage, and Xilonen reduces resistance. Clorinde heals herself while attacking.

t.name: Headed to jail
t.text: Kirara provides Dendro and a shield. Fischl adds Electro damage, while Sucrose shares EM and shreds Electro resistance.

why.v:
General DPS: Use Clorinde with ATK%, Electro DMG, and CRIT for reliable damage in most teams.
Aggravate: Thundering Fury enables longer rotations. Some EM becomes useful, but CRIT and ATK remain important.
Overload: Use Chevreuse with only Pyro and Electro teammates to enable her resistance shred.
CRIT Rate: Clorinde gains up to 20% CRIT Rate during combat. Avoid exceeding 100% after buffs.

seo.about: Clorinde is an on-field Electro DPS who uses Bond of Life to power rapid pistol shots and lunging attacks. Her Skill provides self-healing, while Electro reactions strengthen her damage. She excels in Aggravate, Overload, and Electro-Charged teams.

w.name: Mistsplitter Reforged
w.text: High Base ATK, CRIT DMG and Elemental DMG bonuses make this her strongest general sword.

w.name: Primordial Jade Cutter
w.text: Massive CRIT Rate and a dependable ATK bonus. Watch her Burst passive to avoid excess CRIT Rate.

w.name: Lion's Roar
w.text: Boosts damage against enemies affected by Electro. High refinements make it a powerful 4-star option. Maintain Electro aura. Higher refinements help.

w.name: The Black Sword
w.text: Adds CRIT Rate and Normal Attack damage with a little healing, making her on-field combos more comfortable.

w.name: Iron Sting
w.text: Craftable EM sword that improves Aggravate damage and grants Elemental DMG bonuses after dealing damage. Best with Dendro reactions. Higher refinements help.

w.name: Toukabou Shigure
w.text: Event sword with Elemental Mastery and extra damage to a marked target. Useful in Aggravate if you own it. Limited event availability.

a.text: Boosts Electro reactions and shortens Skill cooldown, giving Keqing extra Skill damage and flexible combos.
Grants Elemental Mastery and ATK from team composition, strengthening Aggravate damage.
a.stats: ATK% or EM / Electro DMG / CRIT

a.text: Boosts damage against Electro-affected enemies. Use only when your team keeps Electro applied reliably.

t.name: Lightning Commission
t.text: Nahida maintains Quicken, Fischl adds powerful off-field Aggravate damage, and Kazuha buffs Electro while reducing enemy resistance. No dedicated healer.

t.name: Moonlit Voltage
t.text: Ineffa enables Lunar-Charged and protects the team. Furina buffs damage while Xilonen heals and reduces resistance for Keqing.

t.name: Overload Authority
t.text: Chevreuse reduces Electro and Pyro resistance after Overload. Fischl helps power Xiangling, whose Burst supplies Pyro. Xiangling needs high ER.

t.name: Pika...chu?
t.text: Yaoyao supplies Dendro and healing, Fischl adds Electro damage, and Sucrose shares EM while reducing Electro resistance.

why.v:
Aggravate DPS: Use Thundering Fury, an Electro Goblet and Dendro support. Fischl is particularly valuable for team damage.
Gilded Alternative: Gilded Dreams is a good choice when its artifact substats beat your Thundering Fury pieces.
Overload: Run only Pyro and Electro teammates with Chevreuse. Xiangling needs considerable Energy Recharge.
CRIT Rate: Keqing gains 15% CRIT Rate after using her Burst, so avoid exceeding 100% after buffs.

seo.about: Keqing is a fast Electro DPS who teleports into combat and chains infused attacks with her Burst. She shines in Aggravate teams, where frequent Electro hits trigger reactions and work especially well with Fischl. Her flexible rotations also support Overload and Lunar-Charged teams.

w.name: Beacon of the Reed Sea
w.text: High CR & ATK bonuses strengthen her Burst & counter. The second ATK bonus requires taking DMG. Strong premium option, especially without a shield.

w.name: A Thousand Blazing Suns
w.text: High Base ATK & CD with an ATK & CD bonus after using her Skill or Burst. Beidou cannot extend it through Nightsoul. The passive has limited uptime.

w.name: Wolf's Gravestone
w.text: Provides a large ATK boost and can buff the party when hitting a low HP enemy. Especially useful with damage bonuses from allies. Its team buff needs a low HP target.

w.name: Verdict
w.text: CRIT Rate and ATK boost her damage. Its Skill bonus needs a teammate to create Crystallize shards, so it is often just a stat stick. More useful with a Geo teammate.

w.name: Serpent Spine
w.text: CR & stacking DMG bonuses are excellent for her snapshotting Burst. Keep the stacks by avoiding DMG before casting. Can outperform five-star weapons with full stacks. Especially strong at R5.

w.name: Akuoumaru
w.text: Boosts Burst damage based on the combined Energy costs of the party. A strong option when teammates have expensive Bursts. Value depends on the whole team. Higher refinements improve it.

w.name: Tidal Shadow
w.text: A craftable ATK claymore that gains more ATK after receiving healing. Useful if your team has a reliable healer. Requires healing to trigger its passive. Higher refinements help.

w.name: "Ultimate Overlord's Mega Magic Sword"
w.text: Provides Energy Recharge and ATK, with an extra ATK bonus based on Melusine quests completed. Useful if you own it. Limited event weapon. Quest completion increases its value.

a.text: Converts Energy Recharge into Burst damage, which suits Beidou since most of her damage comes from Stormbreaker.
a.stats: ATK% or ER / Electro DMG / CRIT

a.text: Combines Burst damage and Electro damage bonuses. A practical choice with stronger existing substats.
a.stats: ATK% or ER / Electro DMG / CRIT

a.text: Boosts damage against enemies affected by Electro. Best when the team maintains that aura consistently.
a.stats: ATK% or ER / Electro DMG / CRIT

t.name: Thunderous Verdict
t.text: Clorinde drives Beidou’s Burst with her Normal Attacks. Nahida sustains Quicken, and Fischl adds damage while helping recharge Beidou. Clorinde heals herself.

t.name: Overload Armada
t.text: Sucrose drives Beidou and Xingqiu with rapid attacks, groups enemies, and shreds resistance. Fischl helps recharge Beidou. All four are 4-star characters.

t.name: Blooming Thunder
t.text: Nahida attacks on field to trigger Beidou and Xingqiu. Kuki heals and triggers Hyperbloom, while Beidou’s Burst adds damage without targeting Dendro Cores.

t.name: Captain’s Taser
t.text: Sucrose drives Beidou and Xingqiu with rapid attacks, groups enemies, and shreds resistance. Fischl helps recharge Beidou. All four are 4-star characters.

why.v:
Off-field DPS: Use Emblem of Severed Fate and keep her Burst available each rotation. Her lightning is strongest when it can jump between enemies.
Energy Needs: With Fischl, Beidou often needs around 140% to 180% Energy Recharge. Solo Electro teams can need far more.
Perfect Counter: Time her Skill just before an enemy attack lands to gain full counter damage and extra Electro particles.
Hyperbloom Flex: Beidou’s Burst does not target Dendro Cores. Pair her with Kuki to trigger Hyperbloom instead.

seo.about: Beidou is an off-field Electro DMG dealer whose Burst sends lightning bouncing between enemies whenever Normal or CAs hit. Her counter rewards good timing, & her Burst also reduces incoming DMG. She shines against groups but needs ER & often a second Electro teammate.

w.name: Gest of the Mighty Wolf
w.text: A top premium choice that grants valuable damage bonuses to his repeated Plunging Attacks. A strong option even without Hexerei support.

w.name: A Thousand Blazing Suns
w.text: High base ATK and CRIT help his damage, while its combat bonuses suit an on-field Pyro carry. Best when his rotation maintains the weapon passive.

w.name: Beacon of the Reed Sea
w.text: Provides CRIT Rate and ATK for strong personal damage. Watch your CRIT cap at C6 or with Marechaussee Hunter. CRIT Rate can overcap.

w.name: Redhorn Stonethresher
w.text: Its large CRIT DMG stat benefits Gaming, although its DEF-based Normal and Charged Attack passive does little for his plunges. Mostly a CRIT stat stick.

w.name: Fruitful Hook
w.text: An excellent Plunging Attack weapon with valuable CRIT Rate and damage bonuses. Becomes exceptional at high refinements. Its buff may miss the opening plunge. Especially strong at R5.

w.name: Serpent Spine
w.text: Offers CRIT Rate and stacking damage bonuses. Shielding helps preserve its stacks during extended combos. Best when stacks remain active. Excellent at R5.

w.name: Rainslasher
w.text: Excellent for Vaporize with its Elemental Mastery and bonus damage against Hydro-affected enemies. Vaporize teams only. Strong at R5.

w.name: Blade of Atonement
w.text: A reliable permanent free option that supports Gaming’s damage without needing limited event weapons. Use at R5 when available. R5 preferred.

a.text: Best overall for Melt and Vaporize. Gaming can build stacks through repeated Skill uses and strengthen his reactions.
a.stats: EM or ATK% / Pyro DMG / CRIT

a.text: His HP changes activate its 36% CRIT Rate bonus. Avoid exceeding the CRIT cap, especially at C6.
a.stats: EM or ATK% / Pyro DMG / CRIT DMG

a.text: Boosts Plunging Attack damage. A strong alternative if you already have good pieces.
a.stats: EM or ATK% / Pyro DMG / CRIT

t.name: Wushou Royal Court
t.text: Citlali enables powerful Melt plunges and lowers Pyro resistance. Nicole adds buffs and shielding, while Xianyun boosts plunge damage and heals.

t.name: Cloudborne Vaporize
t.text: Furina enables Vaporize and boosts damage. Xianyun buffs plunges and heals the team, while Bennett provides ATK and Pyro particles.

t.name: Frostfire Festival
t.text: Citlali supplies Cryo for Melt, Bennett buffs ATK, and Sucrose shares EM and reduces Pyro resistance with Viridescent Venerer.

t.name: Budget Lion Dance
t.text: Use Normal Attacks between plunges to trigger Xingqiu’s Hydro swords. Sucrose supports Vaporize while Bennett buffs and heals.

why.v:
Melt DPS: Crimson Witch with EM Sands works well when Citlali or another Cryo teammate consistently enables Melt.
Vaporize DPS: Use Rainslasher or a premium damage weapon with reliable Hydro application from Furina or Xingqiu.
Marechaussee: With Marechaussee and C6, aim for no more than 44% sheet CRIT Rate for Charmed Cloudstrider.
Before C4: Prioritize enough ER to Burst consistently. C4 greatly reduces his Energy needs.

seo.about: Gaming is a Pyro Plunges DPS who repeatedly launches Charmed Cloudstrider using his Skill & Burst. He excels in Melt & Vaporize teams, where his strong DMG & self-healing make him a powerful four-star carry. His Burst needs enough Energy to stay active each rotation.

w.name: Astral Vulture's Crimson Plumage
w.text: Top premium Melt bow with CRIT DMG and a large Charged Attack bonus after teammates trigger reactions. Strongest in Melt teams.

w.name: The First Great Magic
w.text: High CRIT DMG and Charged Attack damage. Its ATK bonus improves with additional Cryo teammates. Especially strong in Freeze and Mono Cryo.

w.name: Hunter's Path
w.text: Provides CRIT Rate and boosts Charged Attack damage using EM, making it a standout Melt option. Best for Melt. Watch CRIT Rate.

w.name: Amos' Bow
w.text: A classic Ganyu option. Its ATK and Charged Attack bonus grow with arrow travel time, including her Frostflake Bloom. Good in both Melt and Freeze.

w.name: Aqua Simulacra
w.text: Offers huge CRIT DMG and a damage bonus while Ganyu stays near enemies. Its low Base ATK favors external ATK buffs. Stay within passive range.

w.name: Flower-Wreathed Feathers
w.text: Gives ATK and strong Charged Attack damage bonuses. A useful four-star gacha bow for both Melt and Freeze. Stronger with refinements. R5 improves its value.

w.name: Scion of the Blazing Sun
w.text: CRIT Rate and a debuff that increases Charged Attack damage against marked enemies. Avoid excess CRIT in Freeze.

w.name: Hamayumi
w.text: A reliable craftable Melt bow that buffs Charged Attacks, especially when Ganyu keeps her Burst unused. Best for Melt with full Energy. R5 recommended.

a.text: Reliable Melt set with 80 EM and a 35% Charged Attack damage bonus.
Best for traditional Freeze against freezable enemies. Adds substantial CRIT Rate against Cryo and Frozen targets.
Best for Burnmelt when teammates maintain Burning on enemies. Gives a large conditional damage bonus.

t.name: Frostbound Royalty
t.text: Furina buffs and supplies Hydro, Escoffier heals and lowers Cryo and Hydro resistance, and Shenhe empowers Ganyu’s Cryo damage.

t.name: Embers in the Snow
t.text: Emilie and Dehya maintain Burning for Ganyu’s Melt shots. Bennett buffs ATK and heals, while Dehya provides interruption resistance.

t.name: Melt the Mountains
t.text: Xiangling applies Pyro for Melt, Bennett boosts ATK, and Zhongli shields Ganyu while she charges her shots.

t.name: Budget Blizzard
t.text: Xiangling enables Melt, Bennett buffs and heals, and Sucrose shares EM and reduces Cryo resistance. Careful aiming is needed without a shield.

why.v:
Melt DPS: Use Wanderer’s Troupe, an EM Sands, and consistent off-field Pyro. Her Burst can interfere with the Pyro aura.
Freeze DPS: Use Blizzard Strayer and focus on CRIT DMG. Frozen enemies give more CRIT Rate through the set bonus.
Burnmelt: Unfinished Reverie shines when Burning stays active through Emilie or a Dendro and Pyro combination.
Off-field Burst: Prioritize her Burst and enough ER to cast every rotation. A support set or Favonius Warbow can help the team.

seo.about: Ganyu is a Cryo damage dealer whose Frostflake Charged Shots deliver powerful area damage. She excels in Freeze, Melt, and Burning teams. Freeze helps control groups, while Melt rewards precise aiming and reliable Pyro application. Her Burst also makes her a useful off-field Cryo option.

w.name: Key of Khaj-Nisut
w.text: Massive HP boosts shield strength. Skill hits can also grant the team an EM buff based on Kirara’s HP. Stay in parcel form briefly to stack the passive.

w.name: The Dockhand's Assistant
w.text: Its HP secondary stat strengthens Kirara’s shield. The passive is a minor bonus compared with the HP it provides. Best when prioritizing shield strength.

w.name: Freedom-Sworn
w.text: Can provide teamwide Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack damage and ATK buffs after Kirara triggers reactions. Useful in reaction teams that benefit from its buffs.

w.name: Primordial Jade Cutter
w.text: Provides CRIT Rate and a modest HP bonus. Better for personal damage than pure shield utility. Use for a hybrid damage build.

w.name: Favonius Sword
w.text: Generates neutral Energy particles to help the whole team recharge. Build enough CRIT Rate to trigger its passive. Favonius must CRIT while Kirara is on field. Higher refinements ease triggering.

w.name: Sacrificial Sword
w.text: Can reset her Skill cooldown for another shield refresh and extra Dendro particles. Passive needs a Skill hit to trigger.

w.name: Xiphos' Moonlight
w.text: Offers team Energy Recharge based on Kirara’s EM, though a shield build usually stacks HP instead. More useful with some EM investment.

w.name: Sapwood Blade
w.text: Craftable sword with ER. Dendro reactions create a leaf that one teammate can collect for an EM buff. A teammate must pick up the leaf.

a.text: Two HP bonuses strengthen Kirara’s shield without relying on reaction timing or Burst uptime.
Triggering a reaction grants teammates EM. The four-star pieces mean a weaker shield than five-star HP sets.
Reduces enemy Dendro resistance after Skill or Burst hits. Best when no teammate already uses Deepwood.

t.name: Lightning Delivery
t.text: Keqing and Fischl trigger Aggravate while Kazuha groups and buffs Electro damage. Kirara provides shielding and Quicken support.

t.name: Forest Express
t.text: Tighnari deals Spread damage with support from Nahida and Yae Miko. Kirara shields him and generates extra Dendro particles.

t.name: Bloom Delivery
t.text: Nilou enables Bountiful Cores. Nahida supplies Dendro, Kokomi applies Hydro and heals, and Kirara shields against Bloom damage.

t.name: Budget Courier
t.text: Lisa and Fischl deal Aggravate damage. Dendro Traveler maintains Quicken while Kirara protects the team with her shield.

why.v:
Full Shield: Use two HP sets and triple HP main stats for the strongest general shield.
Team Buff: Instructor adds team EM after Kirara triggers a reaction. Expect a weaker shield from four-star artifacts.
Dendro Shred: Choose Deepwood when a Dendro damage dealer needs resistance reduction and no one else carries the set.
Favonius Support: Use a CRIT Rate circlet if needed to reliably generate Energy particles with Favonius Sword.

seo.about: Kirara is a Dendro shielder who protects teammates with her HP-scaling Skill. She excels in quickswap Quicken teams & can support Bloom teams with a second Dendro applier. Her shield is especially effective against Dendro DMG, & her parcel form makes exploration easier.

w.name: Lost Prayer to the Sacred Winds
w.text: Excellent CRIT Rate and growing Elemental DMG while Yanfei stays on the field. Best for long field time.

w.name: Cashflow Supervision
w.text: Huge CRIT Rate and Charged Attack bonuses when her HP changes. Best with Furina and consistent healing.

w.name: Tome of the Eternal Flow
w.text: High CRIT DMG and a powerful Charged Attack bonus when HP changes. Best with Furina and a healer.

w.name: Skyward Atlas
w.text: Provides high ATK and an unconditional Elemental DMG bonus. A consistent premium option.

w.name: The Widsith
w.text: Massive short-term buffs make this a top four-star choice. The random passive and downtime affect consistency. Especially strong in Vaporize. R5 is excellent.

w.name: Sacrificial Jade
w.text: CRIT Rate and EM help Vaporize. Its off-field activation limits longer on-field rotations. Best when rotating her out regularly.

w.name: Flowing Purity
w.text: Craftable ATK catalyst that boosts Elemental DMG after her Skill. Healing clears its Bond of Life for another bonus. Works best with a strong healer.

w.name: Mappa Mare
w.text: Craftable EM option that increases Elemental DMG after Yanfei triggers reactions. Use in reaction teams. Refinements improve its bonus.

a.text: Best general Vaporize set. Buffs Pyro damage and Pyro reaction damage.
Best with Furina when team HP changes reliably. Provides up to 36% CRIT Rate.
a.stats: ATK% / EM, Pyro DMG, CRIT DMG

a.text: Offers EM and an unconditional Charged Attack damage bonus. Excellent for traditional Yanfei builds.

t.name: Courtroom Deluge
t.text: Furina buffs the team, Xingqiu sustains Hydro for Vaporize, and Xianyun heals while enabling Yanfei to Vaporize plunges.

t.name: Crimson Testimony
t.text: Yelan applies Hydro and buffs Yanfei. Bennett boosts ATK and heals, while Kazuha shreds Pyro resistance and groups enemies.

t.name: Overload Objection
t.text: Fischl and Beidou provide off-field Electro damage. Chevreuse buffs Pyro and Electro while Yanfei drives Overloaded.

t.name: Budget Verdict
t.text: Xingqiu enables Vaporize, Bennett heals and buffs ATK, and Sucrose shares EM while reducing Pyro resistance.

why.v:
Vaporize DPS: Use Crimson Witch with EM or ATK Sands. Follow Normal Attacks with Charged Attacks to maintain Hydro reactions.
Furina DPS: Use Marechaussee Hunter with a healer. Lower your external CRIT Rate target to account for its 36% bonus.
Overloaded: Pair Yanfei with Chevreuse and only Pyro or Electro teammates. Prioritize steady off-field Electro application.
C4 Shield Support: At C4, her Burst creates a shield. Use HP and ER with Prototype Amber for a separate support build.

seo.about: Yanfei is an on-field Pyro DPS who powers up her Charged Attacks with Scarlet Seals. She excels in Vaporize teams and can also drive Overloaded reactions. Her attacks reach distant enemies, but she appreciates healing or a shield to avoid interruptions.
weapons: Lost Prayer to the Sacred Winds

w.name: Staff of Homa
w.text: CRIT DMG, HP, and an ATK bonus based on Max HP make this her strongest all-around weapon. Its bonus improves below half HP. Extra value below 50% HP.

w.name: Staff of the Scarlet Sands
w.text: Huge CRIT Rate and ATK based on Elemental Mastery make it excellent for Vaporize. Hu Tao cannot easily gain every passive stack. Especially strong with EM investment.

w.name: Primordial Jade Winged-Spear
w.text: CRIT Rate and stacking ATK help her damage, although she takes time to build stacks and values ATK less than most DPS units. Better when stacks are maintained.

w.name: Lumidouce Elegy
w.text: CRIT Rate is useful, but the passive focuses on ATK and Burning damage. Treat it mainly as a premium stat option for Hu Tao. Passive has limited synergy.

w.name: Ballad of the Fjords
w.text: CRIT Rate and a large EM bonus work well for Vaporize when your team includes at least three different elements. Needs three different elements on the team. Excellent at R5.

w.name: Dragon's Bane
w.text: EM boosts Vaporize, while the passive increases damage against enemies affected by Hydro or Pyro. A standout four-star choice. Best with consistent Hydro application. Scales well with refinements.

w.name: Deathmatch
w.text: High CRIT Rate makes balancing her stats easier. Its ATK bonus is helpful, though less valuable than HP and reaction bonuses. Reliable across team types.

w.name: White Tassel
w.text: A free three-star polearm with CRIT Rate and Normal Attack damage. Use more Normal Attacks between Charged Attacks to benefit. Works best with N2C combos. Aim for R5.

a.text: Boosts Pyro and Vaporize damage without demanding a special team setup. A dependable general build.
a.stats: HP% or EM / Pyro DMG / CRIT

a.text: Grants up to 36% CRIT Rate when HP changes. Best with Furina and a healer who can refresh the stacks.
a.stats: HP% or EM / Pyro DMG / CRIT

a.text: Boosts Normal and Charged Attacks after her Skill, but drains Energy and makes her Burst harder to use.
a.stats: HP% or EM / Pyro DMG / CRIT

t.name: Director of Disaster
t.text: Furina and Yelan provide Hydro damage and powerful buffs. Xilonen heals and reduces resistance, letting Hu Tao Vaporize consistently.

t.name: Plunge into Trouble
t.text: Furina and Yelan apply Hydro and boost damage. Xianyun heals for Fanfare and enables Vaporized plunges between Hu Tao attacks.

t.name: Double Hydro Trouble
t.text: Xingqiu and Yelan keep Hydro active for Vaporize. Zhongli protects Hu Tao and reduces enemy resistance without forcing heals.

t.name: Budget Afterlife
t.text: Xingqiu enables Vaporize, Thoma shields, and Sucrose shares EM and shreds resistance. Set up Pyro Swirl carefully.

why.v:
Classic Vaporize: Use Crimson Witch with Xingqiu or Yelan. Balance HP, EM, and CRIT, and learn Charged Attack cancels.
Furina Teams: Use Marechaussee Hunter with frequent HP changes. A reliable healer helps build Fanfare and keep the set active.
C0 Combos: Jump cancel Charged Attacks to save stamina. C1 removes their stamina cost during her Skill and allows easier dash cancels.
Burst Timing: Use Burst for emergency healing, area damage, or invulnerability frames. Do not sacrifice damage just to Burst every rotation.

seo.about: Hu Tao is an on-field Pyro DPS who uses her Skill to strengthen Charged Attacks and trigger powerful Vaporize reactions. She converts HP into damage and rewards careful stamina management. Double Hydro teams are especially comfortable, while Furina teams need reliable healing.

w.name: Reliquary of Truth
w.text: Best general-purpose premium choice. CRIT stats and Elemental Mastery work especially well in reaction teams.

w.name: Cashflow Supervision
w.text: Excellent in Furina teams. HP changes activate Normal and Charged Attack bonuses, plus ATK Speed. Best with Furina or reliable HP changes.

w.name: Tome of the Eternal Flow
w.text: A premium Furina option with high CRIT DMG, Charged Attack buffs, and Energy recovery. Requires HP fluctuations, usually from Furina.

w.name: The Widsith
w.text: Excellent four-star damage with CRIT DMG and powerful temporary buffs. Performance varies with the random buff and cooldown. Best with planned swap-in windows.

w.name: Dawning Frost
w.text: Strong reaction-focused option with a reliable EM bonus when Bennett is on the team. Best with Bennett in reaction teams.

w.name: Solar Pearl
w.text: CRIT Rate and Normal Attack, Skill, and Burst damage support her on-field rotation. Charged Attacks are not directly buffed.

w.name: Flowing Purity
w.text: Craftable ATK and Elemental DMG option. A healer must clear its Bond of Life to unlock the full bonus. Use a reliable healer.

w.name: Dodoco Tales
w.text: Themed event catalyst that improves Charged Attacks after Normal Attacks. Useful if owned, but weaker than modern options. Past limited-time event weapon.

names: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
a.text: Best all-around set after completing Witch’s Homework. Strong ATK and CRIT Rate bonuses reward her upgraded kit.
Good reaction-focused alternative that buffs Vaporize and Overload damage and benefits from her Skill use.
Strong in Furina teams as HP fluctuations grant CRIT Rate. Adjust your build to avoid overcapping CRIT.

t.name: Kloverload Royalty
t.text: Klee drives Overload while Chevreuse buffs and heals. Durin shreds resistance, and Fischl supplies Electro and Hexerei synergy.

t.name: Explosive Encore
t.text: Furina adds off-field Hydro damage, Fischl activates Hexerei and boosts damage, and Bennett heals and buffs Klee.

t.name: Burning Playdate
t.text: Klee maintains Burning for Emilie. Durin provides Pyro support and Hexerei synergy, while Bennett heals and buffs.

t.name: Fish Blasting
t.text: Bennett buffs and heals, Xiangling adds Pyro damage, and Sucrose groups foes and activates Hexerei after Witch’s Homework.

why.v:
Hexerei DPS: Complete Witch’s Homework for Klee and a second Hexerei teammate. Prioritize Burst uptime and her Spark-enhanced attacks.
Overload: Pair Klee with Chevreuse and off-field Electro. High Pyro application drives reactions, but small foes may be knocked away.
Furina Carry: Furina enables Marechaussee Hunter and HP-dependent weapons. Bring a healer to sustain the team and build Fanfare.
Burning: Emilie and Durin support Burning damage. Unfinished Reverie is an alternative if farming a dedicated Burning build.
C2 Support: At C2, Klee can apply 23% enemy DEF reduction with her Skill and use Thrilling Tales to support a main damage dealer.

seo.about: Klee is an on-field Pyro DPS who floods enemies with explosive attacks. Complete her Witch’s Homework and pair her with another Hexerei character to unlock powerful Spark-enhanced attacks. Overload and Furina teams are excellent, while her C2 also offers DEF shred support.

w.name: Favonius Sword
w.text: Excellent general support choice. High ER and neutral particles help Jean and her teammates use Bursts consistently. Build enough CRIT Rate to trigger its passive.

w.name: Freedom-Sworn
w.text: Premium team buffing option. Especially strong in Sunfire, where Jean triggers frequent Swirls to activate its passive. Prioritize when its teamwide buffs are useful.

w.name: Skyward Blade
w.text: High Base ATK and ER support Jean’s healing, damage, and Burst uptime. A comfortable five-star alternative.

w.name: Primordial Jade Cutter
w.text: High CRIT Rate improves Jean’s personal damage and Favonius-style stat balance, but provides no team Energy utility.

w.name: Xiphos' Moonlight
w.text: Great for EM-focused Sunfire Jean. Converts EM into ER and shares a smaller Energy Recharge bonus with teammates. Best with an EM Sunfire build.

w.name: Amenoma Kageuchi
w.text: Craftable ATK sword that improves healing and refunds Energy after Burst. Refinements make it more comfortable.

w.name: Fleuve Cendre Ferryman
w.text: Free fishing sword with substantial ER and bonus Skill CRIT Rate. Reliable when Favonius is unavailable.

w.name: Sapwood Blade
w.text: Craftable ER sword with high Base ATK. Useful for healing and Burst uptime, though its passive is situational.

t.name: Tidal Windfall
t.text: Jean heals the whole party for Furina’s Fanfare and shreds Hydro RES. Neuvillette leads the damage while Xilonen adds buffs.

t.name: Afterlife Breeze
t.text: Jean heals Furina’s HP drain and shreds Hydro RES. Furina and Yelan enable Hu Tao’s powerful Vaporize attacks.

t.name: Stormfront Sonata
t.text: Raiden drives Electro damage and batteries the team. Furina and Yelan add Hydro damage while Jean heals and Swirls.

t.name: Budget Sunfire
t.text: Jean and Bennett create Sunfire Pyro Swirls. Xiangling adds damage, while Xingqiu provides Hydro for Vaporize.

why.v:
Furina Support: Prioritize enough ER to Burst every rotation. Use 4-piece Viridescent and stack ATK or Healing Bonus for fast Fanfare.
Sunfire Jean: Use Jean and Bennett Bursts together. Level Jean to 90 and prioritize EM and ER for repeated Pyro Swirls.
Favonius Healer: Build CRIT Rate so Favonius triggers reliably. ER and ATK help keep team healing and Bursts consistent.
Damage Jean: Use an Anemo goblet and CRIT circlet if team healing is already sufficient. This trades sustain for personal damage.

seo.about: Jean is a flexible Anemo healer who restores the whole party with her Burst and weakens enemy resistance using Viridescent Venerer. She pairs especially well with Furina by quickly building Fanfare. Her Bennett Sunfire combo adds rapid Pyro application for reaction teams.

t.name: Midnight Tides
t.text: Neuvillette and Furina enable Electro-Charged. Ororon buffs Hydro and Electro with Scroll while Kazuha groups foes and shreds resistance.

t.name: Moonlit Circuit
t.text: Columbina and Ineffa enable Lunar-Charged, while Ifa drives reactions and heals. Ororon adds Electro damage and Scroll buffs.

t.name: Overload Harvest
t.text: Mavuika and Iansan provide Pyro and ATK support. Ororon adds Electro and Nightsoul utility, while Chevreuse boosts Overload teams.

t.name: Budget Night Shift
t.text: Barbara drives Electro-Charged and heals. Fischl adds off-field Electro, Sucrose groups and shreds resistance, and Ororon buffs both elements.

why.v:
Electro-Charged DPS: Use 4-piece Scroll, ATK% Sands, Electro goblet and CRIT circlet. Build enough ER for regular Burst use.
Favonius Battery: Choose Favonius Warbow and prioritize CRIT Rate. Trade personal damage for smoother team rotations.
Lunar-Charged: Pair him with reliable Lunar-Charged enablers. Keep CRIT and ER high, with EM as a useful secondary stat.
Overload Support: Chevreuse teams can use Scroll buffs and Electro application. Full EM is situational when Ororon owns many Overloaded reactions.
Double Electro: With Fischl or another Electro teammate, his ER needs often drop substantially. Shift those rolls toward CRIT and ATK.

seo.about: Ororon is an off-field Electro damage dealer and team buffer who excels in Electro-Charged and Nightsoul teams. His Hypersense passive deals much of his damage, while Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City buffs teammates. He wants reliable Hydro or Nightsoul damage to trigger his passive.

bosses.name: Wavebinder: Stormfang
bosses.mech:
Drinking builds Courage; Electro DMG drains it.
Stellar Glimmer Electro reactions drain more Courage.
Apply Radiance: Stellar Glimmer while it drinks to slow Courage buildup.
Full Courage grants a shield and increased RES.
Depleting Courage removes the shield and deals massive backlash DMG.
bosses.beat:
Prioritize Electro DMG to drain Courage.
Trigger Stellar Glimmer reactions for faster Courage reduction.
Apply Radiance: Stellar Glimmer while it drinks to slow Courage buildup.
Avoid wasting your strongest attacks against its shield.
Once Valiant Assault ends, unleash your strongest attacks during its backlash window.

bosses.name: Emperor of Fire and Iron
bosses.mech:
Pyro horns grant the boss massive RES to all elements.



Horns have greatly increased durability in Stygian Onslaught.



Sternshield Crabs can appear during the fight.



Watch for Radiant Coronation, a powerful AoE attack.
bosses.beat:
Bring a strong Hydro applicator to break the Pyro horns.



Focus on the horns before attacking the boss.



Once broken, the boss is stunned and loses its RES boost.



Use the stun window to unleash your strongest attacks.



Watch your positioning to avoid AoE attacks and crab pressure.

bosses.name: Radiant Moongecko
bosses.mech:
Geo shield has 18 layers on Dire; Geo and blunt attacks break it.



Shield break stuns the boss and lowers Geo RES from 70% to 10%.



Radiant Cocoon drains HP and reduces Crit Rate by 100%.



Healing everyone to 100% removes the debuff and grants 15% Crit Rate and 50% DMG.



Moonstone Anchor wards must be destroyed within 20 seconds or the boss gains 30% ATK.
bosses.beat:
Bring Geo or blunt attacks to break the shield quickly.



Use a strong team-wide healer to restore everyone to 100% HP.



Heal through Radiant Cocoon to remove the Crit Rate debuff and gain its damage bonus.



Destroy all Moonstone Anchor wards within 20 seconds.



Save your strongest attacks for the shield-break stun window.
